new_roles.title: Director of Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
**Corporate Overview**

Aluris Sciences is a contract manufacturing organization (CMO) headquartered in Carlsbad, CA with over 50,000 square feet of manufacturing space. The company is dedicated to serving highly innovative companies in the life sciences, diagnostics, drug-device, and combination product industries. Aluris is a full-service, cost-effective partner, providing complete solutions across technical transfer, formulation, filling, lyophilization, assembly, and final kitting of reagents, consumables, and combination products. Aluris provides quality and regulatory expertise to assure the highest in quality manufacturing and supply chain excellence.

**Position Overview**

The Director of Quality Assurance (QA) is responsible for leading and managing the company’s quality assurance and regulatory compliance programs. This role ensures that all quality systems align with regulatory requirements and industry best practices, maintaining compliance with ISO-13485, ISO 14971, GMP/GLP, QSR, 21 CFR 820.30, and other relevant medical device (IVD) regulations.

The Director of QA will work closely with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to develop and implement strategic quality initiatives, oversee external audits and regulatory inspections, and drive continuous improvement across the organization. This role also involves coaching and mentoring staff, managing compliance metrics, and supporting client engagements by serving as the company’s quality systems representative.

Success in this position requires strong leadership, a deep understanding of quality regulations, excellent communication skills, and the ability to build and maintain a culture of compliance and operational excellence.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and assist in performing all tasks necessary to achieve the organization's mission and help execute growth
* Work with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to formulation and execute the
* strategic vision.
* Work with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to develop and actively manage the company's quality system consistent with the culture and intent of the company
* Oversee and coordinate the quality management systems implementation.
* Accountable for maintaining a state of compliance to f CFR 21 820, 210 and 211.
* Act as the "management representative" within the quality plan.
* Will formulate and lead the management team to maintain ISO 13485 compliance.
* Will assist the leadership in implementation of the technology and process capability roadmap with specific emphasis on validation (10/OQ) and documentation support.
* Will be involved in strategic planning, evaluation, and professional development initiatives.
* Will recruit, hire and manage a motivated and highly talented staff of quality and regulatory professionals
* Provide leadership and/or support as needed throughout the organization, specifically all activities associated with bill of materials structuring, part numbering, SKU attributes, set up, training and quality management systems.
* Represent the quality systems acumen and quality systems capabilities of the company.
* Support all clients engagements as the quality system voice of the company and our capabilities
* Will actively work with the VP of Manufacturing to solve challenges in the production environment related to workflow, internal audits, material dispositions (MRP) and process changes/deviations.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Successfully served in a similar capacity in a contract manufacturing company for a highly regulated market, preferably the life science/pharmaceutical environment.
* Proven credibility as a Quality leader in the life science manufacturing environment.
* Experience and familiarity in reagent formulation, filling and finishing activities with several years of directly related accountability for quality in this form of manufacturing.
* Proven track record of exceptional performance in these FDA regulated environments with audit experience from the FDA and clients
* FDA rapport and relationships are strongly desired
* A familiarity with Lean Manufacturing cultures in a volume production facility
* Experience and proven results in driving process/technology validation efforts.
* Experience and expertise in communication exchanges with clients during tours, meetings, and audits.
* Consistently exhibited through their actions, decisions, and interactions (internally and externally), the highest standards of ethics and integrity.
* The ability to create, direct and implement corporate objectives in an environment with a high sense of urgency
* A proven capability to generate shareholder value
* Negotiation skills to maximize value in client/regulatory body discussions
* Experience building compliance and standardization of processes (building a scalable organization).
* Experience participating in ERP implementations managing and driving documentation control, bills of materials, routings and workflows.
* A track record of recruiting exceptional talent within the economic constraints of a small company.
* A "hands-on" management style with the interpersonal skills required to build a successful team and the desire to motivate, inspire and develop management team members
* High intelligence with effective analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and listening skills.
* A proactive style using initiative and perseverance in order to bring about meaningful change.
* Demonstrated high energy.
* Team Player.

**What to Expect:**

This is a full-time, 100% on-site position based in Carlsbad, CA, with a Monday–Friday schedule and 8-hour workdays, excluding meal breaks. Overtime, weekend, and holiday work may be required as business needs arise.

The position offers a flexible start time between 6:00 a.m. and 9:30 a.m.; however, employees are expected to maintain a consistent schedule. Any exceptions to the established schedule must be approved in advance by the manager.

**What We Offer/Compensation**

At Aluris Sciences, LLC. we value our employees and are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and financial future. Eligible employees enjoy:

**Health & Wellness**

* Medical, dental and vision coverage
* Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
* Company-paid life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage

**Financial & Time Off**

* 401(k) plan with company match
* Paid vacation
* California Paid Sick Leave
* Paid company holidays

**Additional Benefits**

* Employee Assistance Program
* Voluntary and supplemental benefit options

The pay range for this position is $195,000 - $205,000 annually. The final compensation offered will be based on a variety of job-related factors, including geographic location, skills, education, experience, certifications, and other relevant qualifications.

Aluris Sciences, LLC. is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age or disability, or any other class protected by Federal, State or local laws. Argonaut complies will all employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and all must have the authorization to work in the US.

new_roles.title: Director, Quality Engineering
new_roles.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that enable exceptional member and provider experiences. 
The Director, Quality Engineering – Test Data Management (EQE) is a senior technology leader responsible for defining, advancing, and operating Humana's enterprise Test Data Management (TDM) function within Enterprise Quality Engineering. Reporting to the VP, Quality Engineering, this role leads the strategy, operating model, and execution of secure, scalable, compliant, and automation-enabled test data capabilities that support software delivery across Humana's business and technology organizations. 
This leader is accountable for building and leading a high-performing organization responsible for core TDM services, including test data provisioning, synthetic data generation, masking, de-identification, data lifecycle management, and environment data coordination. The Director will partner closely with Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, Privacy, Risk, and Data teams to ensure test data is available, fit for purpose, and aligned to delivery, compliance, and release readiness needs. 
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in test data management, data engineering, governance, privacy, and automation in a complex enterprise environment. This role will drive modernization of TDM practices through automation-first and AI-enabled capabilities, while establishing standards, controls, and reusable services that improve engineering throughput, reduce delivery friction, and strengthen compliance and data protection across non-production environments.

**Responsibilities**

**Leadership, Strategy & Operating Model**

* Lead the enterprise Test Data Management function within EQE, including strategic direction, operating model execution, and organizational development.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of managers, engineers, and test data specialists across multiple groups supporting segment and enterprise needs.
* Oversee a distributed organization of **50+ associates** and create clear priorities, role clarity, and performance expectations.
* Partner with Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Data teams to align TDM services with business and delivery priorities.
* Drive a scalable support model for segment TDM services across multiple portfolios and delivery teams.
* Promote a culture of quality, compliance, continuous improvement, and shared ownership of secure test data practices.

**Test Data Engineering & Management**

 

* Lead enterprise engineering and management of secure, scalable, and compliant test data solutions.
* Oversee delivery of core TDM capabilities, including:Test data provisioningSynthetic data generationData masking and obfuscationData de-identificationData quality enablementTest data automationData lifecycle managementEnvironment data coordination
* Ensure test data is available, fit for purpose, and aligned to quality engineering, release, and environment needs.
* Advance data engineering practices that improve the reliability, reusability, and speed of test data provisioning across delivery pipelines.
* Support complex testing needs across functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and non-production validation use cases.

**AI-Enabled & Automation-First TDM**

 

* Drive **AI-enabled** and automation-first TDM strategies to improve speed, intelligence, scalability, and coverage of test data operations.
* Expand the use of AI and advanced automation for synthetic data generation, sensitive data detection, masking rule optimization, provisioning efficiency, and data quality insights.
* Integrate TDM automation into CI/CD and engineering workflows where applicable to reduce manual effort and increase release confidence.
* Partner with enterprise engineering and platform teams to modernize TDM tooling, workflows, and reusable patterns.

* Ensure compliance with privacy, security, and regulatory requirements related to test data usage, storage, movement, masking, and de-identification.

* Partner with security, risk, privacy, and compliance stakeholders to maintain appropriate controls and audit readiness.

**Use your skills to make an impact**

new_roles.title: Director-Government and External Quality Programs
new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

The Director of Government and External Quality Programs sets the enterprise vision and strategy for government quality and public reporting programs. This role anticipates regulatory and policy changes, represents Intermountain externally, establishes standards and governance, and mobilizes organizational partners to improve quality performance, manage risk, and optimize financial outcomes. The Leader also builds and develops a sustainable center of expertise responsible for accurate, timely, and defensible reporting.

**Essential Functions**

* Sets the enterprise vision and strategy for government quality and public reporting programs. Anticipates the future environment, establishes strategic priorities, and aligns the portfolio with Intermountain’s clinical, financial, and operational goals.
* Shapes Intermountain’s response to evolving policy and regulation. Interprets emerging government priorities, evaluates enterprise impact, and advises senior leaders on strategic decisions, risks, opportunities, and organizational readiness.
* Develops Intermountain’s positions and represents the organization externally. Builds enterprise alignment and serves as a senior representative in government, industry, advisory, and measure-development forums to influence practical and meaningful quality programs.
* Builds strategic partnerships that expand Intermountain’s influence. Cultivates senior-level relationships with government agencies, associations, health systems, health plans, and national quality leaders to anticipate change, shape strategy, and advance shared priorities.
* Establishes enterprise standards for quality measurement and reporting. Provides strategic oversight of measure interpretation, data integrity, abstraction, submission, and public reporting to ensure results are consistent, timely, and defensible.
* Drives enterprise quality performance and financial value. Mobilizes clinical, operational, financial, and technical leaders around priority opportunities and ensures government quality programs translate into measurable improvement and optimized organizational outcomes.
* Establishes governance and executive accountability for program risk. Ensures senior leaders have visibility into performance, financial exposure, readiness, and emerging concerns. Directs the organizational response to significant reporting issues, disputes, and adverse determinations.
* Builds and leads an enterprise center of expertise. Provides strategic direction to government quality reporting teams, develops leaders and subject matter experts, and ensures the organization has the talent, technology, partnerships, and resources needed for long-term success.
 

**Skills**

* Strategic Leadership
* Strategic Planning
* Regulatory Interpretation
* Policy Analysis
* External Relations and Advocacy
* Executive Influence and Communication
* Quality Measurement and Reporting
* Performance Improvement
* Risk Management
* Financial Acumen
* Relationship Building
* Communication

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, public health, nursing, health information management, health policy, business, data analytics, or a related field. Degree must be obtained through an accredited institution. Education is verified.
* Seven years of progressive experience in healthcare quality, regulatory reporting, government healthcare programs, public reporting, value-based care, health policy, or a related field.
* Three years of leadership experience, including responsibility for people, complex programs, or enterprise-wide initiatives.
* Experience interpreting federal or state healthcare regulations, quality program requirements, payment models, measure specifications, or public reporting methodologies.
* Experience developing strategy and leading implementation across multiple departments, facilities, markets, or operational areas.
* Experience advising senior leaders and communicating complex regulatory, clinical, financial, and technical information to varied audiences.
* Experience influencing decisions and achieving results across organizational boundaries without direct authority.
* Experience using quality, operational, and financial information to identify risk, prioritize opportunities, and guide improvement.
 

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in public health, healthcare administration, health policy, business administration, nursing, health informatics, or a related field.
* Experience with CMS hospital quality and payment programs, Medicaid quality programs, state-mandated reporting, or national public reporting and recognition programs.
* Experience representing a healthcare organization on government, industry, advisory, association, or measure-development committees.
* Experience developing organizational positions or formal responses related to proposed regulations, measures, benchmarks, payment methodologies, or public-reporting requirements.
* Experience establishing enterprise governance, regulatory readiness, program controls, risk-management processes, or corrective-action structures.
* Experience leading teams responsible for clinical data abstraction, measure interpretation, validation, regulatory submission, or public reporting.
* Experience building strategic partnerships with government agencies, health plans, associations, peer health systems, or national quality organizations.
* Experience leading a center of expertise, developing leaders and subject matter experts, and establishing succession and cross-training strategies.
 

**Physical Requirements**

* Ongoing need for employee to see and read information, documents, monitors, identify equipment and supplies, and be able to assess customer needs.
* Frequent interactions with providers, colleagues, customers, patients/clients, and visitors that require employee to verbally communicate as well as hear and understand spoken information, needs, and issues quickly and accurately.

Manual dexterity of hands and fingers to manipulate complex and delicate equipment with precision and accuracy. This includes frequent computer use for typing, accessing needed information, etc.

**Location:**

Intermountain Health Intermountain Medical Center

**Work City:**

Murray

**Work State:**

Utah

40

The hourly range for this position is listed below. Actual hourly rate dependent upon experience.

$68.42 - $105.62 
 

We care about your well-being – mind, body, and spirit – which is why we provide our caregivers a generous benefits package that covers a wide range of programs to foster a sustainable culture of wellness that encompasses living healthy, happy, secure, connected, and engaged.

 
 

By applying for a position with Intermountain, I acknowledge that I will comply with all applicable Intermountain policies and expectations. If applying for a remote or hybrid role, this includes remote work expectations related to confidentiality, information security, work schedules, conflicts of interest, and use of company equipment. I further acknowledge that outside employment or activities may not interfere with job responsibilities or create a conflict of interest with Intermountain. new_roles.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**

**Your experience matters**

At Westpark Springs, we are committed to empowering and supporting a diverse and determined workforce who can drive quality, scalability, and significant impact across our hospitals and communities. In your role, you'll support those that are in our facilities who are interfacing and providing care to our patients and community members. We believe that our collective efforts will shape a healthier future for the communities we serve.

**What we offer**

Fundamental to providing great care is supporting and rewarding our team. In addition to your base compensation, this position also offers:

* Health (Medical, Dental, Vision) and 401K Benefits for full-time employees
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program - mental, physical, and financial wellness assistance
* Tuition Reimbursement/Assistance for qualified applicants
* And much more...

**About Us**

**People are our passion and purpose.** Westpark Springs is a 96 bed hospital located in Richmond, TX and is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network committed to making communities healthier® with acute care, rehabilitation, and behavioral health facilities from coast to coast. From your first day to your next career milestone-your experience matters.

**How you'll contribute:**

Leads and oversees a comprehensive, efficient, and integrated hospital-wide Continuous Quality and Performance Improvement (CQPI) program. Uses data collection, analysis, and trending to assess performance; focuses on process and systems improvement; directs risk management and patient safety activities; investigates adverse outcomes; coordinates regulatory/accreditation readiness; and educates staff on CQPI and related quality programs. **This role is 100% onsite.**

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Licensure:** Registered Nurse with current state licensure highly preferred; clinical license required.

**Education:** BSN or BS/BA required.

**Experience:** Minimum two (2) years in an acute hospital or rehabilitation setting required; prior supervisory experience preferred.

**Certifications:** Basic Life Support (BLS/CPR) required; certification preferred by APIC (American Practitioners of Infection Control) and NAHCQ (National Association of Health Care Quality).

**Skills:** Data analysis and reporting; CQPI methodologies (e.g., RCA, FMEA, PDSA); risk management and patient safety facilitation; regulatory/accreditation readiness; effective teaching, communication, and collaboration.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

**Job Specific:**

* Provides leadership and oversight of a comprehensive, efficient and integrated organization wide Continuous Quality Performance Improvement program.
* Measures and assesses performance through collection, analyses, and trending of data.
* Focuses on processes and systems to improve performance.
* Directs, facilitates, and reports on all aspects of services relating to risk management and patient safety.
* Investigates factors contributing to adverse outcomes in order to improve processes and systems.
* Encourages reporting on risk reduction strategies in an atmosphere which minimizes blame or retaliation. Fosters environment to reduce unanticipated adverse events and/or outcomes.
* Responsible for education of Continuous Quality and Performance Improvement and additional hospital-wide education and training.
* Directs the functions and operation of the hospital-wide continuous quality improvement program including review of records for indicators of quality; reports findings to leadership, Medical Executive Committee, the Board of Managers and other committees as appropriate.
* Responsible for education of Continuous Quality and Performance Improvement to hospital and medical staff.
* Annually reviews hospital wide plans for the functions of IC and CQPI and establishes goals and objectives for the next year.
* Acts as a liaison to local health officials, coordinates inspections and accreditation reviews with state and other regulatory agencies.
* Demonstrates knowledge of growth, development, and the aging process for the planning and delivery of age-appropriate care.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Skills:**

* Basic computer knowledge.
* Knowledge of basic equipment.
* Appropriate telephone communication skills.

OSHA EXPOSURE DETERMINATION:

* A key element for a successful Exposure Control Plan is to identify situations that place all employees at risk for exposure. To facilitate this, the Hospital maintains a list of job classifications and contact status for all employees in which employees have occupational exposure to bloodborne pathogens. This position has been identified as Category III: Employees who have no occupational exposure to bloodborne pathogens in the normal performance of job duties.

new_roles.title: Quality/Risk Director
new_roles.description:
**Quality/Risk Director Career Opportunity**

**Highly regarded and valued for your Quality/Risk Director expertise** 
Are you seeking a career that not only utilizes your skills but also aligns with your personal values, providing a profound sense of belonging and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference in patients' lives? Look no further than Encompass Health, the nation's leader in in-patient rehabilitation care. As a Quality/Risk Director, you will oversee a hospital-wide quality management program, collaborating with various stakeholders to monitor and enhance the quality of patient care services. Join a team that values collaboration, support, and inclusivity, and embark on a rewarding career close to home and close to your heart, complete with access to cutting-edge equipment and technology and a comprehensive benefits package from day one.

**A Glimpse into Our World** 
At Encompass Health, you'll experience the difference the moment you become a part of our team. Being at Encompass Health means aligning with a rapidly growing national inpatient rehabilitation leader. We take pride in the growth opportunities we offer and how our team unites for the greater good of our patients. Our achievements include being named one of the "World's Most Admired Companies" and receiving the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® Award, among other accolades, which is nothing short of amazing.

**Starting Perks and Benefits** 
At Encompass Health, we are committed to creating a supportive, inclusive, and caring environment where you can thrive. From **day one,** you will have access to:

* Affordable medical, dental, and vision plans for both full-time and part-time employees and their families.
* Generous paid time off that accrues over time.
* Opportunities for tuition reimbursement and continuing education.
* Company-matching 401(k) and employee stock purchase plans.
* Flexible spending and health savings accounts.
* A vibrant community of individuals passionate about the work they do!

**Become the Quality/Risk Director you've always aspired to be**

* Ensure compliance with regulatory agencies, accrediting bodies, corporate and hospital policies, and procedures. Develop, implement, and maintain quality assessment and improvement programs.
* Assess compliance with federal, state, and industry regulatory and accreditation standards, facilitating processes to remediate and/or maintain compliance. Provide organizational education related to regulations and standards and coordinate local, state, federal, and accreditation surveys.
* Use a variety of applications (including, but not limited to, PatCom, UDS, ORYX, and Press Ganey) to identify improvement opportunities, generate reports, research issues, identify resources, and access external databases.
* Ensure the update and maintenance of hospital plans, including the Provision of Care/Scope of Services, Leadership, Information Management, Utilization Review, Infection Control, and Patient Safety plans. new_roles.title: Quality Control - Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
Stanton is the leading designer and supplier of decorative high quality self-branded carpet, custom fabricated rugs and hard surfaces. Stanton sells its products across the mid to high end residential as well as decorative commercial marketplaces. Stanton is rated #1 Favorite Area Rug Manufacturer for Style, Quality & Service and Top 5 Favorite Carpet Manufacturer among our customers in Floor Focus magazine.
 
 
Stanton is seeking a strategic and technical Director of Quality Control for our Calhoun GA location. This leader will drive the strategic development of a global supplier management program, ensuring that every sourced product meets clearly defined performance criteria and customer expectations. Through thorough vetting and continuous performance monitoring, you will minimize risk and foster a culture of quality excellence. This role is pivotal in upholding Stanton’s commitment to excellence, ensuring our entire product portfolio delivers uncompromised quality, integrity, and performance from the source to the end customer.
 
 
**Responsibilities Include: (but not limited to):** 
Strategic Quality Systems & Standards
 

* Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive Quality Management System (QMS) to track, report, and resolve quality issues across all product lines (carpets, rugs, and hard surfaces).
* Oversee internal and external audits to ensure strict adherence to industry regulations, ISO 9001 standards, and accrediting agency requirements.
* Drive risk avoidance through rigorous and thorough vetting of product quality, performance, and adherence to industry and global standards.

Global Supplier Management & Partnering
 

* Establish and maintain strategic relationships with vendors and manufacturers; monitor supplier performance and evaluate auditing processes to ensure global supply chain adherence.
* Develop and maintain data-driven supplier scorecards to measure and improve quality performance.
* Lead the vetting process for global product suppliers to ensure clearly defined fitness-for-use criteria.

Technical Integrity & Continuous Improvement
 

* Direct testing procedures and routine inspections to assess raw materials and finished products, ensuring durability, aesthetic, and functional specifications are met.
* Lead root-cause analyses and develop Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) plans using Six Sigma or Lean methodologies to eliminate defects and improve efficiency.
* Analyze and report on quality metrics, trends, and performance to executive leadership and regulatory agencies as required.

Operational Oversight & Fiscal Responsibility
 

* Provide complete oversight and management of all downgraded inventory.
* Manage supplier chargebacks, ensuring financial accountability for quality failures.

Leadership & Organizational Culture
 

* Recruit, train, and manage Quality Control personnel, providing oversight of multiple QC inspectors daily.
* Conduct performance evaluations and foster a culture of quality, integrity, and performance excellence within the team.

**Qualifications Include:** 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Quality Management, or a related industrial/scientific field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* 8 to 10+ years of progressive, hands-on quality control/assurance management experience.
* Strong understanding of machine and hand-woven carpet manufacturing process.
* Strong understanding of all hard surface manufacturing.
* Working knowledge of installation procedures.
* Proven expertise in quality control methodologies such as Six Sigma or Lean.
* Deep knowledge of standards such as ISO 9001 and experience with quality management software.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of successful process improvement initiatives.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to train staff and liaise with external parties.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a strategic team.
* Physical Requirements: Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer; must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times to inspect product samples.

new_roles.description:
**SUMMARY:** The Quality Director is responsible for the overall quality of the products manufactured or sourced for our customers.

**RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:**

* Evaluates production operations from a strategic level to ensure products meet quality, integrity, functionality and other specifications and requirements.
* Ensures quality system processes, procedures and records are maintained and effectively implemented. Supports IATF16949 efforts, ensuring the timely follow-up on open issues related to the Quality System.

* Develops and communicates quality goals and performance metrics to achieve company objectives.
* Interacts directly and indirectly with customers to resolve complex issues.

* Collaborates with management and senior staff across departments to develop and maintain quality standards to address internal and external quality requirements.
* Facilitates and oversees the effective implementation of quality controls and risk assessments in new product introductions and change management using established methodologies.
* Oversees quality problem investigations and the implementation of corrective and/or preventative action when the product or process does not conform to stated requirements. Reviews the implementation of effective preventative action based upon the regular review of quality assurance data to reduce variation and waste and meet company goals and objectives. Ensures the timely disposition of non-conforming materials.
* Develops and maintains the warranty and product return process and ensures processes are in place to identify opportunities, create action plans, and to provide feedback for product and process improvements.
* Responsible for the ongoing management and development of assigned employees to produce a high performing quality organization. Determines staffing and skill requirements to meet organizational needs and implements plans to satisfy those requirements.
* Monitors the use and effectiveness of the Quality system process. Reviews metrics and results on a regular basis to identify trends and/or potential problem areas.
* Other duties as assigned.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Quality Systems: ISO 9001/IATF 16949, Internal Auditor, Customer Specific Requirements
* Documentation: Quality inspections, submission change forms, DMS, BOM/Routing, Quality Metrics
* APQP: PPAP, MSA, SPC
* Problem Solving: Corrective Action, Preventive Action, 8D, Root Cause Analysis
* Computer Skills: O365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams), Minitab, SAP (or other ERP system)
* Demonstrated leadership ability
* Ability to interact with all levels of customers

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* B.S. Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
* Minimum 10 years of Quality Engineering experience
* Minimum 5 years of management experience
* Industry experience with ISO9001 (IATF 16949 preferred), APQP, 8D and strong problem-solving skills

 

**Base Pay Range: $140k-$175k**

At Phillips and Temro Industries, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is listed above. Your base pay will depend on your skills, education, qualifications, experience, and location. The final salary offer will be based on these criteria and may differ based on the candidate's experience and qualifications and other job-related reasons. If you have any questions about the salary range, the compensation structure, or benefits offered feel free to reach out to HR@phillipsandtemro.com (mailto:HR@phillipsandtemro.com)

* Paid time off (PTO) and holidays

Alphapointe is a non-profit agency whose mission is to empower people with vision loss to achieve their goals and aspirations. Alphapointe offers a great working environment that's both challenging and satisfying as well as an array of benefits including medical, dental, vision and life insurance, short and long term disability, PTO, paid holidays and flexible spending options as well as a generous 401(k).

**Job****Su****m****mary:**The Director of Quality Assurance position is responsible for establishing a corporate quality assurance system and team that promotes customer satisfaction and that positively impacts the financial performance of Alphapointe. Champion continuous improvement efforts and defect reduction initiatives to establish an effective Quality Management System (QMS) at Alphapointe Kansas City and New York plants.

 

**Essential****Functions:**

 

* Initiates and implements quality improvement activities as appropriate (e.g. Kaizen, Six Sigma) to raise the performance of the company’s product lines.
* Approaches processes with the customer’s purpose in mind.
* Educates and trains employees as to their impact in the quality management system.
* Develops, implements, manages and integrates a QMS for manufacturing plants.
* Serves as the primary quality control resource for problem identification, resolution, loss reporting and continuous improvement.
* Manages quality control personnel on a day-to-day basis.
* Supports concurrent engineering efforts by participating in design development projects representing quality assurance and the customer.
* Designs, implements and documents procedures for process control, process improvement, testing and inspection.
* Establishes and implements metrics (process capability, control charts, measurement quality) for monitoring system effectiveness and to enable managers to make sound product quality decisions.
* Performs root-cause analysis and other problem solving activities to identify effective corrective actions and process improvements.
* Establishes collection and analysis systems of statistical date to predict trends that will affect improvement of product quality.
* Analyze customers’ product specifications to establish efficient, cost-effective requirements for ease of manufacture and reproducibility.
* Develops quality planning methods for all product lines.
* Develops process certification standards and assist in process certification.
* Monitors vendor performance and establish criteria and rating system for critical vendors.
* Reviews customer purchase orders, contracts and change requests and ensure that the necessary criteria and provisions are included in quality and process plans.
* Interacts with customers to identify opportunities to improve quality and establish feedback with manufacturing and development personnel.
* Oversees calibration and testing programs.
* Reports to management on quality issues, trends and losses.
* Reviews suppliers purchase orders and establish supplier quality requirements.
* Participates in internal and external quality audits.
* Interfaces with supplier and customer quality representatives concerning problems with quality control and assure that effective corrective action is implemented.
* All other reasonable duties, as assigned.

 

**Additional****Functions:**

* Coordination of plant safety and health: sponsor training programs and initiatives that promote a safe and healthy work environment.

 

**Kno****w****ledge****and****S****k****ill****Requirement****s**:

* Bachelor’s degree with a preferred major in Industrial Engineering, or other Engineering disciplines or a related field.
* Command of Statistical Process Control Methods and ISO environments is desirable.
* Two years’ work experience managing a quality assurance department in a manufacturing setting.
* Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.

 

**Wor****k****ing****Conditions**:

* Lifting of product containers from assembly line to inspection point.
* Manufacturing environment.
* In-office position

new_roles.description:
At El Pollo Loco, we are on a mission to be the nation’s leading fire-grilled chicken restaurant. When it comes to our people, we are all about growth. Whether that means specialized training, a clearly laid out career trajectory or collaborating cross-functionally, we are committed to the success of our people the same way we’ve been committed to the success of the El Pollo Loco brand for the last 50 years. In fact, we see you as our secret ingredient. While our chicken is fire, it’s our people who set us ablaze.
 
 
Our restaurants are only the tip of the flame! If you’re looking for an innovative, winning, and welcoming workplace, then a flamin’ good career in our Restaurant Support Center is right for you.
 
 
At our Support Center, we believe our best work is done Together, when departments collaborate and everyone is confident in contributing their ideas. This is why we are in the office 3 days per week.
 
 
Let’s Get Loco!
 
 
What’s in it for you!
 
 

* STRONG office culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® and driven by our core values: Simple. Together. Relentless. Ownership. Nimble. Growth
* Career growth opportunities
* Competitive pay and bonus potential
* Be an Owner: Equity Compensation
* Medical + Dental + Vision Insurance + HSA Savings Account
* 401(K) Retirement Plan with company match and immediate vesting
* Paid Vacation + Sick Pay + 12 Paid Holidays
* Employee Assistance Program
* Free El Pollo Loco food + restaurant discounts
* PerkSpot discounts program

**POSITION PURPOSE:** 
The Senior Director, Quality Assurance owns El Pollo Loco's enterprise quality assurance function end to end, consolidating vendor-level quality assurance and regulatory food safety compliance into a single point of accountability. This role is responsible for the integrity of the supply chain's quality systems — from supplier and co-manufacturer qualification through regulatory compliance across federal, state, and local agencies — and serves as the primary quality and food safety resource to the franchise system.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 
Vendor & Supplier Quality Assurance
 

* Directs vendor and supplier quality assurance programs across El Pollo Loco's poultry portfolio, including fresh leg quarters (“Saddles”) and value-added further-processed chicken items, ensuring specification integrity, ingredient consistency, and product quality at every stage of the supply chain.
* Leads vendor qualification, audit, scorecarding, and corrective-action programs; partners with Procurement and Distribution to resolve quality holds, non-conformances, and supplier performance issues.
* Owns quality specifications for co-manufactured and further-processed chicken products, working directly with processors to validate manufacturing controls, shelf-life, and food safety design prior to system-wide rollout.
* Evaluates and approves new vendors, ingredients, and product formulations, ensuring alignment with brand quality standards and regulatory requirements.

Regulatory & Food Safety Compliance
 

* Serves as the company's senior point of accountability for food safety regulatory compliance, including FDA, USDA, FSMA, HACCP, GFSI, and state and local health department requirements across all operating jurisdictions.
* Builds and maintains direct working relationships with state and federal regulatory agencies; leads the company's response to regulatory inquiries, inspections, and enforcement actions.
* Owns crisis management, product withdrawal, and recall protocols (including activation of the Level 3 Withdrawal Process), partnering with executive leadership and legal counsel as needed.
* Directs internal and third-party food safety audit programs spanning restaurants, distribution centers, and manufacturing partners.

Team Leadership & Franchise Support
 

* Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing QA organization spanning both vendor quality and regulatory food safety disciplines; sets performance expectations, coaching plans, and succession pipelines for direct reports.
* Serves as a critical QA partner to the franchise system, delivering training, technical guidance, and responsive support to franchisees on quality and food safety matters.
* Represents Quality Assurance in cross-functional and executive leadership forums, translating vendor and regulatory risk into clear, actionable guidance for Operations and senior leadership.
* Other duties as assigned by the SVP, Supply Chain & Quality Assurance.

QUALIFICATIONS – EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:
 
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. The requirements listed below are representative of the education and/or experience required.
 
 
**Education/Work Experience:** 
BA/BS in Food Science, Food Microbiology, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred. Minimum 12+ years of progressive quality assurance and food safety experience, with substantial, direct experience in poultry and value-added/further-processed chicken products required. Demonstrated background working directly with state and federal regulatory agencies (FDA, USDA, state health departments) on compliance, inspections, or enforcement matters required. Prior experience directly managing and developing a quality assurance team required.
 
 
**License/Certifications:** 
Valid driver's license required. HACCP certification required; PCQI (Preventive Controls Qualified Individual) preferred.
 
 
**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** 

* Proven track record building, managing, and developing high-performing quality assurance teams, with strong people-leadership, coaching, and succession-planning skills.
* Deep working knowledge of value-added and further-processed chicken manufacturing, including co-manufacturer oversight, specification management, and shelf-life validation.
* Established credibility with state and federal regulatory agencies; skilled at navigating inspections, audits, and enforcement proceedings with composure and precision.
* Demonstrated ability to support and train franchisees on quality and food safety standards, balancing brand protection with practical, field-level guidance.
* Confidence in execution of strategic initiatives; decisive and able to make fact-based decisions under pressure.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset and skills; meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to effectively communicate with internal and external business partners, including vendors, regulators, and franchisees.
* Ability to prioritize and plan competing, time-sensitive work assignments under frequent, tight deadlines.
* Ability to read, write, and interpret complex regulatory reports, contracts, and correspondence.
* Ability to exercise independent judgment on matters of significant risk and consequence to the company.
* Ability to work weekends and extended work schedules as needed.
* Willing and able to travel locally within Southern California and to out-of-state vendor, distribution, and restaurant locations, as needed, by car or airplane.

Our Company
 
 
In 1980 the first American El Pollo Loco opened on Alvarado Street in Los Angeles, quickly becoming a destination for the best citrus-marinated, fire-grilled pollo in town. Over the past four decades, El Pollo Loco has grown into more than 500 restaurants across 9 states, becoming an L.A. mainstay and cultural benchmark along the way. Today, we continue to work just as hard to always provide our customers with Quality Chicken. Fast. Easy. Affordable.

This range does not include any benefits or bonus opportunities that might be available for the position based on position and eligibility criteria. At El Pollo Loco, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the high end of the range. new_roles.title: Vice President of Operations
new_roles.description:
At Emmi Roth, we’re passionate about creating exceptional cheeses. As a leader in the specialty cheese industry, we blend traditional craftsmanship with innovation. Our commitment to local sourcing and quality makes us a trusted brand in the food industry.

Joining Emmi Roth means becoming part of a team that values creativity, collaboration, and a shared dedication to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work with some of the finest cheeses in the world while contributing to a company that prides itself on both heritage and progress. If you're passionate about food, craftsmanship, and making an impact, we’d love for you to be a part of our journey!

**Summary** 
The Vice President of Operations serves as a core member of Emmi Roth’s Executive Leadership Team, shaping and advancing the enterprise’s operational agenda across all manufacturing sites. This role defines the long-term Operations vision, aligns enterprise strategy with operational priorities, and ensures sustained, world-class performance across safety, quality, service, cost, and sustainability.

Operating with full executive authority within established governance frameworks, the Vice President of Operations partners closely with the VP of Supply Chain to jointly steward end-to-end value chain outcomes, balancing performance, resilience, and growth.

**Duties and Responsibilities** 
**Executive Accountability & Scope** 

* Enterprise-wide accountability for operational outcomes across all manufacturing facilities, including safety, quality, service, productivity, cost, and ESG outcomes
* Strategic leadership of the Operations function, establishing strategic direction, enterprise priorities, and performance frameworks that enable long-term success
* Oversight of manufacturing, production, employee safety, food safety, maintenance, engineering, R& D and operational excellence capabilities, with full decision authority across these domains
* Ownership of the Operations P&L, including financial performance, capital allocation, and long-range investment strategy, with authority to direct resources within approved plans
* Definition and advancement of a multi-year Operations strategy aligned with Emmi Roth and Emmi Group objectives
* Enterprise accountability for compliance, risk management, and governance across food safety, quality, regulatory, environmental, and employee safety standards
* Strategic partnership with the VP of Supply Chain to co-own value chain performance, aligning trade-offs and outcomes across service, cost, inventory, and supply continuity
* Leadership of organizational capability, including leadership and development, succession planning, and leadership pipeline development within Operations

**Executive Leadership and Responsibilities** 

* Active contributor to enterprise strategy and decision-making as a member of the Executive Leadership Team
* Drives and owns organizational design and functional maturity, ensuring the Operations organization evolves in line with business growth and complexity
* Strategic liaison with Emmi Group Supply Chain leadership, ensuring alignment, transparency, and global integration
* Executive sponsor of capital strategy, manufacturing network evolution, automation, and digital transformation initiatives, with authority aligned to enterprise investment governance
* Executive representative of Operations with internal and external stakeholders, reinforcing credibility, influence, and enterprise alignment

**Strategic & Operational Leadership** 

* Translate enterprise strategy into integrated operational priorities, roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes
* Leverage data, insights, and forward-looking indicators to anticipate risk, identify opportunity, and guide enterprise-level decisions
* Champion enterprise initiatives, including continuous improvement, advanced manufacturing, automation, and productivity acceleration
* Establish and uphold enterprise-wide performance systems, ensuring transparency, rigor, and accountability at all levels
* Foster a culture grounded in safety, quality, ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Provide leadership in navigating complex, cross-functional challenges, ensuring alignment and decisive, enterprise-level resolution

 
**Qualifications** 
Required qualifications, skills, and experience for the job; education background, certifications, relevant work experience, technical skills, and soft skills. 

* Degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related discipline
* MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred, or comparable experience
* Extensive senior leadership experience within Operations, preferably in complex manufacturing environments
* Demonstrated success within food manufacturing
* Proven accountability for operational P&L performance and capital investment strategy
* Track record of leading enterprise transformation and large-scale operational initiatives
* Fluency in English required; additional languages advantageous

**Competency Profile** 

* Enterprise-oriented leader with the ability to balance strategic vision and operational depth
* Decisive, outcomes-focused leader with demonstrated ownership and accountability for outcomes in complex environments
* Collaborative value chain leader, adept at aligning cross-functional priorities and delivering integrated results
* Exceptional developer of talent, with a focus on leadership capability, succession, and organizational effectiveness
* High degree of leadership presence, emotional intelligence, and resilience, with the ability to influence at all levels

**Benefits** 

* Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance
* Basic Life Insurance
* Voluntary Life Insurance
* Flexible spending accounts & Health Savings Accounts
* 401k Retirement Plan
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Vacation
* Employee Assistance Program
* Short term/Long term disability
* Volunteer time off (VTO)
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Pet insurance

**The Best Cheese Moments are EMMI ROTH Moments!**

*Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled*

Description:

### **JOB SUMMARY:**

The General Manager reports directly to the President and leads the Watertown, Connecticut location. This role translates company strategy into daily execution and is accountable for site performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, employee engagement, and customer satisfaction.

As a member of the Leadership Team, the General Manager establishes operational controls, reporting systems, and performance expectations to improve profitability, workforce development, manufacturing efficiency, and long-term business sustainability. The role collaborates with Sales, Finance, Engineering, Human Resources, Quality, and Operations across locations.

### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

#### **Operational Leadership & Strategy:**

* Lead daily site operations and align departmental priorities, resources, and execution with company strategy.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and monitor performance indicators for safety, quality, on-time delivery, labor efficiency, inventory accuracy, first-pass yield, productivity, and profitability.
* Use operational reports and dashboards to identify performance gaps, assign corrective actions, and monitor results.

#### **Process & Financial Performance:**

* Manage site operational budgeting, labor planning, cost controls, and financial performance in collaboration with Finance and within approved authority.
* Lead initiatives to reduce waste, improve workflow, standardize processes, and apply lean manufacturing principles.
* Coordinate production priorities and resource planning across departments and locations to support customer commitments.
* Evaluate and implement approved technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to improve efficiency and reduce non-value-added work.

#### **Safety, Quality & Customer Collaboration:**

* Manage and continuously improve the site safety program in coordination with designated company resources; ensure adherence to applicable company policies and safety and environmental requirements.
* Ensure site adherence to applicable quality management systems and ISO requirements; support audits, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Sales, Engineering, Quality, and customer-facing teams to address customer needs, delivery commitments, product quality, and issue resolution.

#### **Leadership & Talent Development:**

* Lead and mentor department managers and operational leaders to improve accountability, consistency, and professional development.
* Develop succession plans and leadership development initiatives to strengthen organizational depth and business continuity.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, employee

Requirements:

### **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provide site-level leadership and oversight of department managers and operational leaders within the assigned reporting structure.
* Establish performance expectations, provide regular feedback, and assess development needs in coordination with Human Resources and company leadership.

### **QUALIFICATIONS:**

#### **Required Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong business acumen and understanding of manufacturing operations, finance, quality systems, supply chain, customer service, sales support, and workforce management.
* Ability to lead operational change, build trust, and develop accountability and employee engagement across organizational levels.
* Proficiency in manufacturing metrics, operational reporting, financial analysis, and cost controls.
* Experience implementing process improvements, lean manufacturing initiatives, and operational standardization.
* Ability to use ERP/MRP systems, reporting tools, and other business systems to improve operational effectiveness.

#### **Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field preferred, but not required.
* At least eight years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, printing, converting, industrial production, or a related operational environment.
* Demonstrated success leading teams in a fast-paced manufacturing environment with responsibility for operational performance and measurable business results.
* Experience with custom manufacturing, technical products, labels, graphic overlays, membrane switches, or related industries preferred.
* Experience managing within ISO-certified or regulated manufacturing environments preferred.

### **LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

* Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present information internally and externally across organizational levels.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills strongly preferred to support employee engagement, training, and operational communication.

### **MATHEMATICAL & ANALYTICAL SKILLS:**

* Ability to interpret budgets, labor and production data, costs, inventory reports, and operational performance trends.
* Ability to use data to evaluate priorities, identify causes of performance gaps, and assess improvement results.

### **REASONING ABILITY:**

* Ability to think and act strategically and tactically, manage competing priorities, and make sound operational decisions.
* Ability to analyze problems, evaluate alternatives, and coordinate practical solutions across departments.

### **WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* Work is performed in office and manufacturing settings, with exposure to moving production equipment when entering production areas.
* Follow applicable site safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment in designated areas.
* Travel to customers, vendors, and JN White corporate as needed.

**Position Type and Compensation** 
This is a full-time, salaried, exempt position based in Watertown, Connecticut. The annual base salary range is $120,000–$150,000. Compensation within this range will be determined based on relevant experience, qualifications, skills, and internal equity.

**Benefits** 
JN White offers medical, dental, and vision insurance, with premium costs shared between the employee and employer. A variety of ancillary insurance benefits are also available; employee contributions and employer contributions, where applicable, vary by coverage elected.

Additional benefits include paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, a 401(k) retirement plan, and profit sharing. Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements, waiting periods, company policies, and governing plan documents. Profit sharing is subject to plan terms and is not guaranteed.

**Equal Employment Opportunity** 
JN White is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, age, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**Reasonable Accommodations** 
JN White provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees as required by applicable law. Applicants who need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process may contact Human Resources.

**Employment Disclaimer** 
This posting describes the general nature of the position and does not constitute an offer of employment or an employment contract. Employment with JN White is at will, subject to applicable law. Duties and responsibilities may change based on business needs.

new_roles.description:
**Job Title: Plant Manager**

**Job Type: On-Site**

**Location: Orange, CA**

**Reporting to: VP of Manufacturing**

**Company Overview**

FXI is a leading producer of foam innovation in the Bedding, Furniture, Industrial, Home & Office, Healthcare, and Transportation markets. We have made it our mission to provide tailored solutions that delight our customers and consumers. With our corporate headquarters, high-tech research and development facility, and multiple manufacturing locations in North America, FXI has built a culture of innovation and achievement that is recognized by customers, suppliers and peers. Our products include finished goods, sub-assemblies, services, and raw materials for OEMs, fabricators, and retailers. You will find FXI's foam innovations inside, around, and under yourself in countless applications. Everywhere foam goes, FXI's innovations lead the way! Won't you join us?

**Job Overview:**

Reporting to the Manufacturing Vice President, the Plant Manager plans, directs, and coordinates the operations of the plant. The Plant Manager has leadership responsibility to assure compliance with all government and company policies and procedures. This position will also be responsible for facility production goals and objectives. Following FXI's Vision, Mission and Values, the Plant Manager is to develop a well-trained and motivated staff with emphasis on plant safety and employee engagement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Chemical, or related discipline) preferred.

* Direct and coordinate plant operations in strict compliance with all state and federal laws, regulations, corporate policies and procedures
* Responsible for achieving all facility business goals including, but not limited to, the areas of safety, quality, production, reliability and P&L.

* Maintain a clean and safe plant; incorporate a 5S culture for conducting all work activities.

* Develop and foster a high‑performing, well‑trained, and motivated workforce by assessing current skill sets and aligning talent development with the plant's future growth, vision, and manufacturing excellence across all functions.

* Lead the development, implementation, and governance of plant performance metrics and KPIs to monitor progress toward site objectives and drive continuous improvement.

* Conduct and assure all required employee development and performance reviews are completed to promote individual continuous improvement per the required corporate schedule.

* Attend scheduled corporate training and meetings. Need to be a key leader moving the company forward to meet strategic and business plan objectives.
* Ensures that all plant assets are properly managed, safeguarded, and secure.

* Develop, submit for approval, and implement approved Capital Projects as required to meet facility strategic plans and business needs.

* Develop and ensure management systems are in place to monitor plant output, cuts / yields and scrap to ensure efficient resource utilization and initiate corrective action as required.

* Establish and maintain a positive community relationship.

**Qualifications:**

* 10 years of prior experience in a manufacturing environment
* Prior experience as Production / Operations Manager.
* Strong interpersonal, problem solving and leadership skills with the ability to lead a team motivate the group and manage a diverse workforce.
* Excellent, engaging communicator; able to set measurable goals and expectations and hold team members accountable for results

* Demonstrated experience and working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles and structured problem‑solving tools (e.g., 5S, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, Root Cause Analysis, A3, 5 Whys) to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.

* Action-oriented and eager to drive programs through to completion. Able to deal with pressures and timelines inherent in a fast-paced company
* Ability to quickly assess the situation at the plant and have an impact on the direction of improvements
* Ability to function as a strong leader, bringing the Operations perspective while promoting cross-functional horizontal alignment to achieve key company goals
* Hands-on leader who contributes to overall business strategy and issues, works well as part of the leadership team, and is focused upon achieving results
* Team player and coach who will promote cooperation among employees in the organization and an environment of employee engagement
* Possess the confidence and presence to be able to deal effectively with external customers, vendors, and all levels within the organization
* Strong, self-confident, decisive leader with excellent listening skills, emotional maturity, and ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment

**Our Commitment to a Diverse Workforce:** FXI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. FXI does not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or based on any individual's membership in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. We support workplace diversity. We strongly believe that diversity contributes to a broader collective perspective that will consistently lead to a better company and better products. We are working hard to increase the diversity of our team wherever we can.

new_roles.title: VP, Manufacturing - Fresh Bakery
new_roles.description:
**Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell’s brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao’s Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder’s of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.**

**Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.**

**Why Campbell’s…**

* Benefits begin on day one and include medical, dental, short and long-term disability, AD&D, and life insurance (for individual, families, and domestic partners).
* Employees are eligible for our matching 401(k) plan and can enroll on the first day of employment with immediate vesting.
* Campbell’s offers unlimited sick time along with paid time off and holiday pay.
* If in WHQ – free access to the fitness center. Access to on-site day care (operated by Bright Horizons) and company store.
* Giving back to the communities where our employees work and live is very important to Campbell’s. Our “Campbell’s Cares” program matches employee donations and/or volunteer activity up to $1,500 annually.
* Campbell’s has a variety of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support employees.

**Job Description**

The Vice President, Manufacturing – Fresh Bakery provides strategic and operational leadership for Campbell’s Fresh Bakery manufacturing network, including bakery operations in Bloomfield, Connecticut; Downers Grove, Illinois; Lakeland, Florida; and Denver, Pennsylvania. This leader establishes the manufacturing strategy, operating priorities, performance expectations, and transformation agenda for the network, ensuring consistent execution across safety, quality, service, cost, reliability, productivity, and people.

Leading through the Plant Managers, the VP creates alignment across sites while maintaining clear site-level accountability for day-to-day operations and results. The role builds manufacturing capability and organizational talent across the network, identifies and addresses systemic performance opportunities, and drives continuous improvement and transformation to strengthen the long-term competitiveness of the Fresh Bakery business.

This leader partners across Supply Chain and the broader organization to align manufacturing strategy, capabilities, capacity, capital priorities, and resources with business needs. The incumbent must be an enterprise-minded business partner who creates direction, enables effective decisions, builds talent and culture, drives disciplined execution, and owns results across the network.

**Essential Job Duties**

**Manufacturing Strategy & Network Leadership:** Define and lead the multi-year manufacturing strategy for the Fresh Bakery network. Translate business and Supply Chain priorities into clear site objectives, integrated roadmaps, operating plans, and performance expectations. Maintain clarity between network-level strategic direction and Plant Manager ownership of daily site operations.

**Safety, Quality & Operating Integrity:** Set expectations and governance for employee safety, food safety, product quality, environmental responsibility, and regulatory compliance across all bakery sites. Ensure effective management systems, standards, controls, and escalation routines are in place, while holding Plant Managers accountable for site execution and results.

**Network Performance Management & Accountability:** Establish the operating cadence and performance-management system for safety, quality, service, cost, labor, yield, waste, reliability, customer service, and employee engagement. Review performance across sites, identify systemic gaps and best practices, define corrective actions, and ensure clear ownership and follow-through.

**Manufacturing Transformation & Operational Excellence:** Lead the transformation agenda for Fresh Bakery manufacturing, creating consistent operating systems, standards, and management routines across the network. Build a culture of continuous improvement and zero loss, and use Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance, equipment reliability, and problem-solving disciplines to deliver sustainable improvements.

**Cost, Productivity & Business Performance:** Deliver network productivity, cost, waste, and efficiency commitments through disciplined planning and execution. Connect operational performance to financial outcomes, evaluate trade-offs, and mobilize cross-site resources to address significant performance gaps or opportunities.

**Capacity, Capability & Capital Strategy:** Shape network capacity, capability, technology, and capital priorities based on demand, growth, service, risk, and long-term business needs. Sponsor major capital and capability initiatives, ensure disciplined prioritization and governance, and partner with Engineering and other functions to achieve intended business outcomes.

**Talent, Leadership & Culture%:** Build a strong and diverse manufacturing leadership pipeline across the Fresh Bakery network. Coach and develop Plant Managers and senior site leaders; strengthen succession, bench strength, workforce planning, engagement, and retention; and create a high-performing culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

**Cross-Functional & Enterprise Partnership:** Partner with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Research & Development, Commercial, Finance, People & Culture, and other stakeholders to align priorities, solve network constraints, support innovation and commercialization, manage risk, and deliver enterprise outcomes. Serve as the senior manufacturing voice for the Fresh Bakery business.

**Required Education & Skills**

· Bachelor's degree strongly preferred or an Associate's degree with significant experience.

· Fresh Bakery manufacturing experience strongly preferred

· 15+ years of progressive manufacturing/operations experience

· Prior experience as a Plant Manager, General Manager, Director of Site Operations, or comparable senior manufacturing leader

· Significant people leadership experience, including leadership of senior operational leaders

· Demonstrated manufacturing leadership experience

· Multi-site leadership experience, likely something I'd make required or strongly preferred

**Preferred Experienc** e

· Multi-site manufacturing leadership experience, including leadership through Plant Managers or comparable senior site leaders.

· Experience in food manufacturing or consumer packaged goods (CPG) within a complex, high-volume manufacturing network.

· Demonstrated experience leading large-scale manufacturing transformation and operational excellence, with a track record of driving sustainable improvements in safety, quality, service, cost, reliability, and productivity.

· Experience applying Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), reliability, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies at scale.

· Experience developing manufacturing network strategy, including capacity, asset utilization, capital investment, and long-term capability planning.

· Demonstrated experience developing senior manufacturing leaders and building succession and bench strength across multiple operations.

· Experience managing significant operating budgets, productivity commitments, capital investments, and/or P&L responsibility.

· Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to work across Planning, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Procurement, Finance, Commercial, R&D, and People & Culture to deliver business outcomes.

· Advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

This role requires regular work in manufacturing environments and a visible presence across bakery facilities, including walking, standing, climbing stairs, and accessing production, warehouse, and office areas. The incumbent must be able to wear required personal protective equipment and work a flexible schedule as business needs require.

**Travel**

This role requires **at least 75% travel** , primarily to Campbell’s Fresh Bakery manufacturing sites and Headquarters. Regular and sustained on-site presence is expected to provide visible leadership, build strong partnerships with Plant Managers and site leadership teams, understand operating conditions firsthand, and support execution of manufacturing priorities and transformation initiatives

 

**Compensation and Benefits:**

The target base salary range for this full-time, salaried position is between

$221,500-$304,600

Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. Total pay may include other forms of compensation. In addition, we offer competitive health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. Please ask your Talent Acquisition Partner for more information about our total rewards package.

**The Company is committed to providing equal opportunity for employees and qualified applicants in all aspects of the employment relationship, including consideration for employment, without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, marital status, protected veteran status, disability, age, religion, or any other classification protected by law.**
