new_roles.description:
**Work Location** :

New York, New York, United States of America

**Hours:**

40

**Line of Business:**

TD Securities

**Pay Detail:**

$225,000 - $225,000 USD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

**Job Description:**

Conducts a range of comprehensive analysis and research on individual corporations, industries, financial markets and/or economic developments to support business needs and publish high quality research reports/presentations aligned to industries and various markets. Also provides critical insights and industry information to support advisory services.

 

**Depth & Scope:**

* Highly seasoned professional role requiring substantial knowledge / expertise in a complex field and knowledge of broader related areas
* Takes a lead role in modeling and interpretation of advanced insights within research reports
* Integrates knowledge of sub-function's overarching strategy in developing solutions across multiple functions or operations
* Interprets internal/external business challenges and the industry environment, recommends course of action and best practices to improve products, processes, or services
* Solves or may lead others to solve complex problems; leads efforts or partners with others to develop new solutions
* Uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgement and identify solutions
* Communicates difficult concepts; converts information to compelling business context and advice; influences and gains alignment across increasingly senior stakeholders
* Acts as a technical expert / lead integrating cross-functional knowledge, impacting the achievement of business objectives
* Work is guided by policies and industry standards/methods
Works autonomously as the lead and guide others within area of expertise 

 

**Education & Experience:**

* Undergraduate degree
* Masters or PhD preferred
* CFA designation preferred for publishing analysts and associates
5+ years related experience 

 

**Customer Accountabilities:**

* Works closely with the sales and trading group to develop new relationships, and with other analysts and associates to provide ongoing guidance
* Develops and maintains contacts and relationships in the community and with institutional clients
* Leads in the compilation and evaluation of multiple data inputs for:
 + Companies/industries and/or
 + Financial markets and economic analysis research reports (e.g., initiating coverage reports, thematic reports, quarterly reporting initiatives, and marketing packages)
* Publishes high quality, comprehensive analysis and research on industry sectors and companies and/or financial markets and economic development
* Develops business relationships and generates profits from producing and sharing regular research publications
Provides service to clients (internal and external) in the form of information, expertise, analysis, and opinions regarding market information, financial markets, economic outlook, and investment strategies 

 

**Shareholder Accountabilities:**

* Keeps abreast of market data, economic information, and key industry developments, as well as internal policies and regulatory standards (as communicated by Compliance) at all times to assist in maximizing profitability through sound and well-informed decisions; develop and maintain contacts with market participants
* Demonstrates governance, control, and risk management behaviors in alignment with TD policies and practices
* Adheres to enterprise frameworks or methodologies that relate to activities for our business area
* Ensures respective programs/policies/practices are well managed, meets business needs, complies with internal and external requirements, and aligns with business priorities
* Consistently exercises discretion in managing correspondence, information, and all matters of confidentiality; escalate issues where appropriate
* Participates in cross-functional/enterprise initiatives as a subject matter expert helping to identify risk/provide guidance for complex situations
* Conducts internal and external research projects; support the development/delivery of presentations and communications to management or broader audience
* Conducts meaningful analysis at the functional or enterprise level using results to draw conclusions, make recommendations, assess the effectiveness of programs/policies/practices
* Monitors service, productivity, and assess efficiency levels within own function and implement continuous process/performance improvements where opportunities exist
* Actively manages relationships within and across various business lines, corporate, and/or control functions and ensures alignment with enterprise and/or regulatory requirements
Maintains a culture of risk management and control, supported by effective processes in alignment with risk appetite 

 

**Employee/Team Accountabilities:**

* Participates fully as a member of the team, support a positive work environment that promotes service to the business, quality, innovation, and teamwork, and ensure timely communication of issues/points of interest
* Provides thought leadership and/or industry knowledge for own area of expertise and participate in knowledge transfer within the team and business unit
* Keeps current on emerging trends/developments and grow knowledge of the business, related tools, and techniques
* Participates in personal performance management and development activities, including cross training within own team
* Keeps others informed and up to date about the status/progress of projects and/or all relevant or useful information related to day-to-day activities
* Contributes to team development of skills and capabilities through mentorship of others, by sharing knowledge and experiences and leveraging best practices
* Leads, motivates, and develops relationships with internal and external business partners/stakeholders to develop productive working relationships
* Contributes to a fair, positive, and equitable environment that supports a diverse workforce
Acts as a brand ambassador for your business area/function and the bank, both internally and/or externally 

 

**Physical Requirements:**

Never: 0%; Occasional: 1-33%; Frequent: 34-66%; Continuous: 67-100%

* Domestic Travel – Occasional
* International Travel – Never
* Performing sedentary work – Continuous
* Performing multiple tasks – Continuous
* Operating standard office equipment - Continuous
* Responding quickly to sounds – Occasional
* Sitting – Continuous
* Standing – Occasional
* Walking – Occasional
* Moving safely in confined spaces – Occasional
* Lifting/Carrying (under 25 lbs.) – Occasional
* Lifting/Carrying (over 25 lbs.) – Never
* Squatting – Occasional
* Bending – Occasional
* Kneeling – Never
* Crawling – Never
* Climbing – Never
* Reaching overhead – Never
* Reaching forward – Occasional
* Pushing – Never
* Pulling – Never
* Twisting – Never
* Concentrating for long periods of time – Continuous
* Applying common sense to deal with problems involving standardized situations – Continuous
* Reading, writing, and comprehending instructions – Continuous
Adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing – Continuous 

 

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required. The listed or specified responsibilities & duties are considered essential functions for ADA purposes.

**Who We Are**

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

**Our Total Rewards Package** 
Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes base salary and variable compensation/incentive awards (e.g., eligibility for cash and/or equity incentive awards, generally through participation in an incentive plan) and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off (including Vacation PTO, Flex PTO, and Holiday PTO), banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition. Learn more

**Additional Information:** 
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.
 
 
**Colleague Development**

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

**Training & Onboarding** 
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.
 
 
**Interview Process** 
We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

**Accommodation**

TD Bank is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you are an applicant with a disability and need accommodations to complete the application process, please email TD Bank US Workplace Accommodations Program at USWAPTDO@td.com . Include your full name, best way to reach you and the accommodation needed to assist you with the applicant process.

new_roles.title: Quality/CI Director
new_roles.description:
**Job Summary**

The Quality/CI Director is responsible for overseeing the overall quality management system and lean management systems; including the continuous development, improvement & maturity, and supporting the forward vision & business objectives of the segment. This position will support with a dotted line, 40+ plant locations and will work under the general direction of the Regional VP positions.

 

**Location**

Any UFP packaging plant in TX, AZ, OK, OR, UT preferred.

 

**Principle Duties and Responsibilities**

* Oversees the overall quality management systems of the business segments and their impact on our business & customers.
* Oversees the overall continuous improvement program for the business segment through standardized practices, training, meeting improvement objectives, and continuing to mature our systems and capabilities.
* Assist the plant locations in maintaining compliance with the quality management system to ISO9001 requirements and sustaining our certification status.
* Assist quality & CI training to plant quality managers/coordinators as turnover occurs.
* Drive standardization into our quality management & lean management systems insuring best & consistent practices.
* Assist new methodologies & technologies which impact quality & improvements (such as software & SCADA systems).
* Support onboarding of new and strategic customers within PPAP processes.
* Provide training & training material for the CI program & initiatives. Serve as coach & mentor for improvement projects.
* Host regional CI progress meetings with each region to help support progress & best practices.
* Take initiative on developing next steps & objectives to evolve & mature the effectiveness of our systems and provide necessary training.
Provide high level analysis from data/metrics of how effective our systems are and make recommendations and/or take action for improvement. 

 

**Qualifications**

* CQE ( *certified quality engineer* ) Certification Preferred or equivalent discipline body of knowledge.
* Minimum of five years of experience in Quality manufacturing environment is required.
* Working knowledge of ISO9001 QMS systems, and preferred understanding of IATF 16949 (formally TS) & AIAG practices.
* Working knowledge of Quality Science applications.
* High-level understanding of lean concepts & applications.
* Six Sigma Black belt preferred
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Access. NOTE! Must be proficient with charts & statistical formulas/templates in Excel.
Manager level Leadership knowledge/experience. 

*The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

new_roles.title: Director, Contract Manufacturing--Remote
new_roles.description:
Empowering Physicians. Improving Lives.
 
 
Are you ready to join a team that is redefining the medical device industry?
 
 
AngioDynamics develops innovative medical technologies that empower physicians to deliver improved care and patient outcomes globally. We believe that people living with society’s most challenging diseases deserve trusted medical solutions that deliver high-quality care, wellness, and cures to live healthier, happier lives.
 
 
Invested in You
 
 
We believe world-class innovation starts with world-class people. In this role, you will be surrounded by top talent and equipped with in-depth training to maximize your potential and accelerate your career.
 
 
Total Wellness
 
 
AngioDynamics helps physicians deliver better care for their patients. We take the same approach with our own people. Our comprehensive benefits package supports your health and your loved ones, so you can do your best work.
 
 
Ready to make a lasting impact on patient care? Learn more about this role below.
 
 
JOB SUMMARY – To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.
 
 
The Director of Contract Manufacturing is responsible for developing and executing the company's contract manufacturing strategy to ensure reliable supply, consistent product quality, cost competitiveness, and operational scalability. This role oversees the selection, qualification, development, and ongoing performance management of external manufacturing partners to support current business requirements and future growth.
 
Working cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Engineering, Research and Development, Finance, and Commercial teams, the Director ensures that contract manufacturing partners meet established standards for safety, quality, service, cost, compliance, and delivery.
 
 
The ideal candidate is a strategic and results-oriented leader with a strong background in external manufacturing, supplier relationship management, manufacturing operations, sustaining engineering, and continuous improvement. This individual will build strong partnerships, mitigate supply chain risks, drive operational efficiencies, and establish a scalable contract manufacturing network aligned with the company's long-term business objectives.
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
 
1. Contract Manufacturing Strategy
 

* Develop and implement the contract manufacturing strategy in alignment with company objectives, production requirements, and growth plans.
* Evaluate and optimize the external manufacturing network, including capacity, capabilities, geographic footprint, cost structure, and risk exposure.
* Identify, assess, and qualify new contract manufacturers to support new products, increased demand, and business expansion.
* Lead make-versus-buy assessments and provide recommendations regarding outsourcing, insourcing, and manufacturing footprint optimization.
* Develop long-term manufacturing partner strategies to ensure flexibility, scalability, and business continuity.

2. Contract Manufacturer Relationship Management
 

* Establish and maintain strategic relationships with contract manufacturing partners, serving as the primary executive-level point of contact.
* Negotiate manufacturing agreements, service-level expectations, pricing structures, capacity commitments, and performance objectives in collaboration with Procurement and Legal.
* Establish clear governance processes, business reviews, escalation protocols, and performance improvement plans.
* Drive accountability and transparency across external manufacturing partners.
* Resolve complex operational, commercial, and relationship issues to protect business performance and customer commitments.

3. Operational Performance and Supply Assurance
 

* Oversee contract manufacturer performance related to production planning, capacity utilization, on-time delivery, lead times, yield, and throughput.
* Ensure manufacturing partners maintain adequate capacity, materials availability, staffing, and production readiness to meet forecasted demand.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Planning teams to align demand forecasts, production schedules, inventory targets, and capacity plans.
* Develop contingency plans and risk mitigation strategies for supply disruptions, quality issues, capacity constraints, and geopolitical or logistical challenges.
* Lead recovery plans when external manufacturing operations fail to meet required service or production targets.

4. Quality, Compliance, and Regulatory Oversight
 

* Partner with Quality and Regulatory teams to ensure contract manufacturers comply with applicable regulatory requirements, company standards, and contractual obligations.
* Ensure appropriate supplier qualification, audits, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), change control, and continuous compliance processes are in place.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring defects, deviations, customer complaints, and manufacturing nonconformances.
* Promote a culture of quality, product safety, accountability, and continuous improvement across the contract manufacturing network.
* Ensure manufacturing changes, process validations, and product transfers are appropriately controlled and documented, creating standard work for each key process and CM transaction.

5. Financial Management and Cost Optimization
 

* Develop and manage the contract manufacturing budget, including conversion costs, tooling, capital expenditures, and other external manufacturing expenses.
* Identify and execute cost reduction initiatives through process improvements, yield enhancement, productivity gains, material optimization, and commercial negotiations.
* Analyze cost drivers and manufacturing economics to improve total cost of ownership without compromising quality or service.
* Establish financial performance metrics and monitor actual results against budgets and targets.
* Support annual operating plans, long-range financial planning, and business cases for new manufacturing partnerships or capacity investments.
* Manage consignment inventory program – insuring planning alignment to forecast requirements. Establish standard reporting requirements.

6. New Product Introduction and Manufacturing Transfers
 

* Partner with Research and Development, Engineering, Quality, and Commercial teams to transition new products from development into commercial production.
* Oversee manufacturing readiness, process scale-up, technical transfer, validation, and production ramp-up activities.
* Ensure contract manufacturers have the technical capabilities, equipment, processes, and resources necessary to meet product specifications and volume requirements.
* Manage timelines, risks, and cross-functional deliverables associated with product launches, manufacturing transfers, and commercialization initiatives.

7. Performance Metrics and Continuous Improvement
 

* Establish and maintain a standardized contract manufacturer scorecard and key performance indicator (KPI) framework.
* Monitor performance against targets for quality, delivery, cost, service, productivity, and compliance.
* Lead regular operational reviews and executive business reviews with strategic manufacturing partners.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, root-cause analysis, and other operational excellence methodologies.
* Benchmark partner performance and implement best practices across the manufacturing network.

8. Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration
 

* Lead, develop, and mentor contract manufacturing, supplier management, or external operations personnel, as applicable.
* Establish clear priorities, performance expectations, and accountability across internal teams and external partners.
* Build strong cross-functional relationships to align manufacturing decisions with business needs.
* Communicate manufacturing performance, risks, opportunities, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Champion a culture of collaboration, ownership, continuous improvement, and disciplined execution.
* May perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS –The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill or ability required.
 
 
Education and Experience
 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business, or a related field required.
* Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or Supply Chain Management preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, supply chain, procurement, or external manufacturing.
* 5+ years of experience managing contract manufacturers, outsourced production, or strategic manufacturing partners.
* Demonstrated success developing manufacturing strategies, managing supplier performance, and improving operational and financial results.
* Experience negotiating manufacturing agreements and managing complex supplier relationships.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives, product transfers, capacity expansions, or manufacturing scale-ups.
* Experience working in a multi-site, global, or complex manufacturing environment preferred.

Skills/Knowledge
 

* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, capacity management, and supply chain operations.
* Demonstrated expertise in supplier relationship management, contract negotiations, and performance management.
* Strong financial acumen, including cost modeling, budgeting, and cost reduction.
* Knowledge of quality management systems, supplier audits, risk management, and corrective action processes.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to influence stakeholders and drive results across organizational boundaries.
* Proficiency with ERP systems, supply chain planning tools, and data-driven performance reporting.
* Willingness and ability to travel to manufacturing partner locations as required.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal).
* Ability to effectively communication both internally and externally.
* Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance. instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected status.
 
 
AngioDynamics does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from third-party recruiters and/or vendors who are not expressly under current written contract.
 
 
Your ultimate salary may vary depending on your job-related skills, knowledge, and experience.

new_roles.description:
### **At Materion, everyone is included, respected and offered opportunity to grow.** ***Join us!***

**Position Summary**
====================

The Director of Operations, Premium Targets provides strategic and operational leadership for a complex, multi-site manufacturing organization with domestic and international operations. This leader is accountable for safety, quality, delivery, cost, customer performance, talent development, capital execution, and continuous improvement. The individual in this role will lead Operations, Supply Chain, and Engineering teams, including manufacturing facilities across multiple locations. As the organization’s senior operations safety leader, the Director sets clear expectations, models visible safety leadership, empowers employees to identify and address hazards, and holds leaders accountable for proactive risk reduction and continuous EHS improvement. Working across Technology, Quality, Supply Chain, Commercial, Engineering, EHS, and other functions, the Director translates business priorities into sustainable results, standardizes manufacturing and business processes, and delivers exceptional service to internal and external customers. The role also leads operations strategy and financial performance, including gross margin, inventory turns, and cost management.

**Operations Leadership and Execution**
=======================================

* Lead a proactive, prevention-focused safety culture in which every employee is empowered and expected to identify hazards, stop unsafe work, and take ownership of a safe and healthy workplace.
* Lead manufacturing operations across Buffalo, Wheatfield, Albuquerque, Limerick, and Brewster, with strong matrix partnerships supporting Alzenau and Taiwan.
* Own performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, reliability, and customer commitments; establish clear metrics, review performance routinely, and hold site leaders accountable for results.
* Set and execute the Premium Targets operations strategy, multi-year roadmap, and long-range capital and workforce plans.
* Ensure facilities consistently deliver high-quality products on time to internal business units and external customers.
* Partner with Technology, Quality, Supply Chain, Commercial, Engineering, EHS, and other functions to align priorities and improve end-to-end performance.
* Develop, coach, and hold operational leaders accountable for business results, team effectiveness, and talent growth.
* Strengthen communication, operating discipline, and knowledge sharing across all Premium Targets facilities.
* Provide clear, timely business updates and recommendations to senior leaders and key stakeholders.

**Operational Excellence, Strategy, and Capital Leadership**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Champion EHS excellence by ensuring regulatory compliance, audit readiness, effective risk assessments, timely incident and near-miss investigation, corrective-action closure, and consistent use of leading and lagging safety indicators.
* Serve as executive sponsor for the Premium Targets Lean manufacturing transformation.
* Advance daily management, structured problem solving, kaizen, standard work, process improvement, and cost-reduction practices across sites.
* Partner with Lean resources and site leaders to implement improvements and sustain measurable gains.
* Lead major capital programs, equipment installations, expansions, and facility transitions in partnership with Engineering, corporate, business-unit, and capital teams.
* Ensure capital initiatives meet approved cost, schedule, quality, and performance objectives while integrating safety into design, installation, commissioning, and startup.
* Develop manufacturing and supply chain strategies that support production, maintenance, planning, EHS, technical capability, and customer requirements.
* Partner with Commercial teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
* Enable best-practice sharing and process standardization across manufacturing locations.
* Lead financial performance improvement, with a focus on gross margin, inventory turns, and cost management.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, business, or a related field.
* At least 10 years of progressive experience in a manufacturing environment, including significant manufacturing operations people leadership responsibility with a demonstrated ability to develop leaders and build high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated success leading safety and EHS performance, manufacturing operations, continuous improvement, engineering, and capital projects.
* Ability to lead end-to-end processes and deliver results through cross-functional and matrixed teams.
* Ability to travel up to 50%.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in engineering, business administration, or a related field.
* Leadership experience in a multi-site or international manufacturing organization.
* Experience leading a Lean transformation or enterprise-wide operating system.
* Experience managing major capital programs, facility expansions, installations, or transitions.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic and systems-oriented thinking, with the ability to translate business priorities into executable operating plans.
* Strong influence, collaboration, and negotiation skills, including the ability to secure alignment and resources across functions.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication with team members, peers, customers, and senior leaders.
* Sound judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguity, reconcile differing viewpoints, and make timely decisions.
* Visible, values-based leadership grounded in safety, integrity, accountability, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated commitment to coaching, succession planning, and the growth of talent across all levels.

Pay Range:

$148,500.00 - $237,100.00

*Actual base salary offered varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location.*

**The selection of the person to be hired for this position is contingent on the candidate having export compliance eligibility for access to U.S. controlled technology which comes under the licensing jurisdiction of the U.S. Department of State, International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the U.S. Department of Commerce, Export Administration Regulations (EAR).**

**The candidate selected will have to qualify as either a U.S. citizen, a U.S. National, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., a Person Admitted into the U.S. as an Asylee or Refugee., a National of a country that is not prohibited from having access to U.S. controlled technology (via a letter of assurance), or a Person to be approved for an export license by the governing agency whose technology comes under its jurisdiction. new_roles.title: Director of Engineering (Food Manufacturing Plants)
new_roles.description:
**Director of Engineering (Food Manufacturing)**

Dessert Holdings is the leading premium dessert company in the world. We craft artisanal, scratch-made desserts at scale, combining culinary innovation with the finest real ingredients. With a rich heritage spanning seven distinctive brands, we bring unmatched expertise and tailored solutions to our Retail and Foodservice partners.

Dessert Holdings is looking for a **Director of Engineering**to be based in **Humble, TX** or ideally near one of our production facilities, who will travel as needed to sites for projects. Under the direction of the VP of Engineering & Reliability and in coordination with Corporate and Site Management teams, this individual will provide technical and professional leadership for project management and engineering across Dessert Holdings' tenFood Manufacturing Plants. This role is responsible for capital projects and for identifying, vetting, and championing new manufacturing opportunities and new or emerging technical advancements. This position requires strong personal initiative to identify opportunities, achieve engineering standardization, and implement asset and process best practices within the Dessert Holdings manufacturing facilities.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide engineering counsel and leadership for multiple facilities and internal and external project engineers.
* Manage and execute all facets of Dessert Holdings capital projects such as building expansions, and capacity expansion including brownfield and greenfield projects.
* Identify and champion cost reduction projects (capital and non-capital) through process or equipment improvements, capital automation, and robotic opportunities.
* Define technology and manufacturing capabilities to support new business and line extensions.
* Aid with developing 3/5-Year Capital Plan, including originating capital appropriation requests, developing project schedules and work teams, writing of contracts, coordinating project activities, controlling project funds, and implementing startup/training procedures as necessary.
* Write capital projects that include preparation of studies, proposals, estimates, technical reports, capital required, cash flow on approved CEA format.
* Assist in the development and implementation of new facility planning and construction. Includes developing packages, creating equipment and construction specifications, establishing and tracking project budgets, utility utilization, EPA and OSHA requirements, knowledge of GMP's, writing and justifying projects.
* Administer project bid documents and assist with rewarding contracts to outside vendors, architects, and engineers.
* Create and maintain the appropriate engineering records including equipment records and manuals, drawings and diagrams, inspection reports and legal records as required by the appropriate agencies.
* Maintain effective reporting and communication with the appropriate people both within and outside of the plant.
* Work closely with outside agencies in their respective fields, i.e., OSHA, EPA, FDA, etc., to ensure plant compliance with current regulations.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering required or equivalent technical degree. Substantial applicable experience will also be considered.
* 10-15 years of engineering leadership with progressive technical and/or management experience including project management and extensive food manufacturing experience
* Ability to travel up to 75%, throughout the US (8 sites) and Canada (2 sites)
* Hands on approach to problem solving with creative solutions and ability to handle ambiguity
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Understand business implications of decisions, align work with strategic goals
* Ability to prioritize and plan work activities, set goals, timelines, and objectives
* Display original thinking, creativity and resourcefulness to generate innovative approaches and ideas
* Ability to create and drive automation opportunities including robotic manufacturing capability
* Possess leadership skills and the ability to effectively manage and communicate with engineers, construction personnel, project managers, clients and executives
* Demonstrated proficiency in Word, Excel, Gantt, Power Point, AutoCAD, and project planners
* Familiarity with controls, process, packaging, electrical, mechanical, refrigeration systems
* Knowledge of six sigma and Lean Manufacturing principles

**About Dessert Holdings**

Dssert Holdings is a collection of premium dessert companies and brands: The Original Cakerie, Lawler's Desserts, Atlanta Cheesecake Company, Steven Charles, Dianne's Fine Desserts, Kenny's Great Pies, and Willamette Valley Pie Company. Dessert Holdings is owned by Bain Capital, is headquartered in St. Paul, Minnesota, employs more than 3,500 people across ten manufacturing facilities, and is continuing its journey of rapid growth.

**EEO Statement**

Dessert Holdings and its related entities provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or any other characteristics protected by law.

new_roles.title: Director of ITAD Operations
new_roles.description:
**Director of ITAD Operations**

 

**A Candid Look at Our Culture**

Dynamic is a high-accountability, low-ego workplace. We take our work and commitments seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously.

At **Dynamic Lifecycle Innovations**, we give electronics their next best life while protecting our planet and our customers' interests. As a Certified Great Place to Work® since 2017, we've built a team culture that's rewarding, engaging, and FUN! But don't just take our word for it—see what our Team Members have to say.

**How We Hire: The Head, Heart, and Briefcase**

We believe great performance comes from alignment across three areas:

* **Head** – your natural behavioral drives and cognitive agility (measured by our Predictive Index assessment)
* ❤️**Heart** – your values, passions, and what drives you to make a meaningful impact
* **Briefcase** – your experiences, skills, and results from past roles

Every step of our process is designed to understand you in all three areas. It's how we ensure the best mutual fit, not just for what you can do, but for how you'll thrive here long-term.

**\*\*Required Step** **- You'll start with the Predictive Index (PI) assessment** (takes <20 minutes total), then move through structured interviews, work samples, and culture-focused interviews. We respect your time and promise clear, timely communication throughout.

**Location:** Onsite within our Onalaska, WI, or Hendersonville, TN facilities.

**Total Cash Compensation (Base + Bi-Annual Incentive):** $170,000 - $250,000

**Benefits Include:**

* Comprehensive health benefits starting the first of the month following hire
* 401(k) with company match
* Quarterly incentive opportunity
* Generous paid time off and paid holidays

**Your Purpose**

As the Director of ITAD Operations, you'll lead the people and operations that give technology its next best life. Our IT asset disposition (ITAD) facilities operate much like manufacturing environments, where production flow, labor planning, equipment, inventory, quality, and safety all contribute to performance. If you've led manufacturing operations and enjoy developing people while improving how work gets done, your experience could make a significant impact here.

Reporting to the Executive Vice President of ITAD, you'll turn strategy into results across Dynamic's primary and satellite facilities. You'll develop leaders, strengthen operational consistency, and use data and technology to improve efficiency, profitability, and customer satisfaction.

This is an opportunity to shape how our operations grow. From improving processes on the floor to building the capabilities needed across multiple locations, your leadership will help Dynamic process IT assets securely, efficiently, and profitably while advancing our mission.

**What You'll Do**

* **Lead operations across multiple facilities.** Turn business priorities into clear operating plans, align leaders around shared goals, and drive consistent execution across primary and satellite locations.
* **Develop leaders who develop their teams.** Coach, mentor, and empower your leaders to build team capability, own results, and prepare future leaders through training and succession planning.
* **Improve production flow and performance.** Apply Lean manufacturing practices, Gemba walks, and root cause analysis to remove bottlenecks, reduce waste, and improve productivity and quality.
* **Make performance visible and actionable.** Build dashboards and scorecards that help teams understand results, recognize issues early, and take ownership of improvement.
* **Connect operational decisions to profitability.** Manage labor, costs, and budgets while aligning production schedules and capacity with business demand and customer commitments.
* **Use technology to improve how work gets done.** Partner across teams to strengthen ERP use, inventory management, and process automation as operations grow.
* **Protect our people and our customers' trust.** Hold high standards for safety, quality, environmental compliance, and data security while ensuring customer assets are handled securely, and service commitments are met.

**What You Bring (Briefcase)**

* Bachelor's degree in operations management, business administration, engineering, supply chain management, or a related field. Additional relevant experience will be considered in lieu of formal education.
* Eight or more years of progressive operations leadership experience, including significant experience managing teams and operational performance. Demonstrated success leading complex, high-volume processing, manufacturing, reverse logistics, refurbishment, or ITAD operations.
* Experience leading operational teams across multiple facilities and developing leaders who deliver consistent results.
* Demonstrated success improving operational performance through continuous improvement, financial discipline, and data-informed decisions.
* Preferred: MBA
* Preferred: Knowledge of IT asset disposition, secondary markets for IT equipment and components, and the processing requirements of servers, networking equipment, storage systems, and GPUs.
* Preferred: Familiarity with R2, e-Stewards, NAID AAA, and ISO standards, along with ITAD data security and environmental compliance requirements.
* Preferred: Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma, Total Quality Management, or the Toyota Production System.

**Skills & Abilities (Head)**

* Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement practices, including Kaizen, 5S, Gemba walks, and root cause analysis.
* Financial acumen connecting operational decisions to gross margin, operating expenses, and overall profitability.
* Understanding of forecasting, labor and capacity planning, and Sales & Operations Planning.
* Ability to use ERP systems, inventory management technology, production planning, and automation to improve operations.
* Analytical skills to build actionable dashboards and scorecards that make performance visible in real time.
* Clear communication, active listening, and project management skills that help teams align and execute.
* Leadership skills in coaching, mentoring, training, delegation, and succession planning.

**❤️** **Who You Are (Heart)**

You're a leader who connects strategy with what happens on the floor. You set clear expectations, listen closely, and help people understand how their work contributes to the bigger picture. You're comfortable digging into the data, asking thoughtful questions, and working alongside your teams to solve problems.

You hold high standards for results and how they're achieved. You build accountability through trust, develop leaders who can own their decisions, and look for better ways to work without losing sight of safety, quality, or the customer. You bring the judgment to balance today's operational demands with the capabilities Dynamic needs for its next stage of growth.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

**Purpose with Impact:** Help give electronics their "next best life" while protecting the planet 
 **Award-Winning Culture:** We put people first as a Certified Great Place to Work® since 2017 
**Executive Influence:** Shape long-term enterprise strategy with your executive peers

**Transform at Scale:** Lead the modernization of technology, data, and AI through growth
 **Build Something Lasting:** Dynamic is privately owned without PE – our focus is long-term, sustainable growth, and you'll help us build a foundation to enable decades of success

* **️** **Equal Employment Opportunity**

Dynamic Lifecycle Innovations is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing fair employment opportunities for all based on merit. For positions subject to state contract requirements, we adhere to state affirmative action obligations and take proactive steps to ensure equal opportunity in our hiring practices. We do not discriminate or make any employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations-Life Sciences
new_roles.description:
**Who we are:**

Charter Medical, part of the Solesis family of companies, specializes in single-use solutions that enable life sciences innovators to turn bold ideas into lasting breakthroughs, supporting industry-leading companies in bringing life-saving therapies to market. Operating in North Carolina, Charter Medical employs more than 150 team members across two facilities in Winston-Salem.

Guided by a commitment to quality, innovation and customer success, Charter partners with customers to transform promising therapies into commercial realities. Employees contribute to solutions that support life-changing treatments and make a meaningful impact on patients around the world.

**1st shift Monday-Friday 8:00 am-5:00 pm**

**About the role:**

The Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for the site, with full accountability for Profit & Loss (P&L) performance, manufacturing excellence, and sustainable, profitable growth in single-use cell processing and biopharmaceutical manufacturing. The role translates Charter Medical’s mission into operating priorities that advance purpose-built, customizable processing solutions, reduce the cost and risk of delivering advanced therapies, and enable customers to scale reliably. By aligning capacity, capital investment, innovation, quality, and workforce capability with customer demand, the Director fosters a culture of safety, compliance, responsiveness, collaboration, urgency, and continuous improvement—helping biopharmaceutical innovators make life-changing therapies more accessible to patients.

**What you will do:**

* Lead all site manufacturing operations to ensure safe, compliant, reliable, and profitable execution of customer demand.
* Own site P&L performance, including revenue attainment, EBITDA, gross margin, labor and overhead management, productivity, spending, savings, and budget execution.
* Develop and execute the site operating plan and manufacturing strategy in alignment with company objectives, customer demand, and growth priorities.
* Direct manufacturing execution, facilities, maintenance, and continuous improvement activities to achieve Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People objectives.
* Ensure effective utilization of labor, equipment, materials, information, and facility capacity to improve throughput, yield, lead time, asset utilization, and on-time delivery.
* Establish, review, and act on key performance indicators and performance trends through daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual operating reviews.
* Evaluate and improve manufacturing methods using knowledge of product requirements, materials, fabrication processes, tooling, equipment capability, work methods, and quality-control standards.
* Lead capacity planning and resource allocation to support current production, new business, customer growth, and future site requirements.
* Develop, justify, prioritize, and execute capital investment plans supporting safety, compliance, capacity, automation, productivity, business continuity, and site growth.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, delivery, yield, scrap, labor productivity, cost reduction, flow, and equipment reliability.
* Ensure product availability through disciplined execution of the production plan and alignment of labor, materials, equipment, and technical support.
* Support new-product introductions, technology transfers, pilot builds, process scale-up, design-for-manufacturability reviews, product validations, and commercialization activities.
* Partner with Commercial and Product Development teams to assess manufacturing capability, support customer opportunities, align operational commitments, and respond to changing demand.
* Serve as the senior manufacturing representative during customer visits, business reviews, audits, regulatory inspections, CAPA activities, and issue-resolution efforts.
* Ensure manufacturing execution meets product specifications, documentation, and traceability requirements and supports compliant delivery.
* Build and maintain robust manufacturing training and qualification programs in partnership with Human Resources.
* Develop annual operating budgets, forecasts, staffing plans, productivity targets, and capital plans; monitor performance and implement corrective actions when results fall below plan.
* Oversee product-costing inputs based on actual manufacturing performance, labor productivity, yields, scrap, material usage, and operational assumptions in partnership with Finance.
* Identify staffing requirements; participate in selection and hiring; build organizational capability to meet operational and growth requirements.
* Coach, mentor, and develop operations leaders and employees; establish clear expectations, provide ongoing feedback, manage performance, and support succession and career development.
* Partner with Human Resources to maintain an effective organization structure, conduct talent reviews, improve employee engagement, and develop leadership capability.
* Foster a culture of safety, accountability, quality, customer focus, collaboration, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement throughout the site.
* Ensure adherence to site safety requirements, PPE practices, environmental expectations, and applicable Health, Safety, and Environmental systems.
* Maintain strong communication across shifts, departments, and leadership so priorities, risks, decisions, and customer commitments are clearly understood.
* Act independently with a high degree of judgment and initiative to resolve complex manufacturing and business issues and develop recommendations for senior leadership.

***Please note that Charter Medical does not provide employment visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship both now or in the future.***

**Who you are:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations, business, life sciences, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing experience, including significant experience in a regulated life sciences, biopharmaceutical, medical device, or comparable environment.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in manufacturing management, plant leadership, or director-level role.
* Demonstrated experience owning or significantly influencing a manufacturing P&L, operating budget, productivity plan, and capital portfolio.
* Demonstrated ability to lead managers and cross-functional teams, coach employees, resolve conflict, and drive accountability.
* Working knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices, FDA expectations, ISO-based quality systems, and regulated manufacturing documentation.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, equipment capability, facilities, maintenance, cost drivers, and operational workflows.
* Considerable knowledge of ERP systems and proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Effective written, verbal, presentation, analytical, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work across shared-service and matrixed organizations.
* Ability to use Lean Six Sigma and structured problem-solving methods to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and business performance.
* Lean Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Experience in cleanroom manufacturing preferred.
* Experience supporting biopharmaceutical customers, customer audits, and contract manufacturing operations preferred.
* Experience leading capacity expansion, automation, technology transfer, or operational transformation initiatives preferred.

**Perks / Benefits:**

* Generous Paid Time Off
* Paid Breaks
* Annual Bonus
* 401(k) with excellent company match
* Health Insurance with multiple plans to choose from
* Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_roles.title: Sr. Director Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
* Manage performance. Work with the Plant Leadership Team to track plant targets and KPIs regularly and set action plans and follow-up meetings to close gaps.
* Own KPI visibility. Manage the daily, weekly, and monthly KPI charting and posting process to keep teams accountable.
* Simplify data. Use Power BI and SAP to turn complex operational data into clear, usable information for plant and operations leaders.
* Apply analytics. Use statistics and other analytical methods to identify improvement opportunities and support decisions.
* Track savings. Implement and manage a cost savings tracking process aligned with corporate standards and deliver against savings targets.
* Partner on safety. Partner with the Safety Director to embed safety into improvement work, including incident investigation, hazard reduction, and safety considerations in kaizen events.
* Perform other duties as assigned

 
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, business, engineering, food science, or related field, or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
* 7 to 10 years experience in a manufacturing environment, including a leadership role.
* 5+ years in influencing roles, such as CI, Lean, or support functions.
* Experience or education in statistical process control, root cause analysis, or other analytical methods.
* Training and hands-on experience with value stream mapping, kaizen methods, 5S, leader standard work, and other Lean tools.
* Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver on timelines, budgets, and goals.
* Experience developing or implementing a playbook for a management operating system (MOS) and a continuous improvement program, including how the playbook was rolled out across sites.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SAP and Power BI for operational reporting.
* Experience in food or consumer packaged goods manufacturing.
* Experience with Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), with at least working exposure to its Autonomous Maintenance (AM) and Planned Maintenance (PM) pillars.

**Skill and Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence leaders at every level.
* Diplomacy in communicating needs and recommendations, with credibility that earns trust across functions.
* A proactive style that drives projects to completion despite obstacles.
* A collaborative team approach in all situations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams at once.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

 **Additional Information**

*The salary range for this role is $195,000 - 225,000 annually*

Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Employer** 
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

new_roles.title: Director, Operations
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

Veolia in North America is the top-ranked environmental company in the United States for three consecutive years, and the country’s largest private water operator and technology provider as well as hazardous waste and pollution treatment leader. It offers a full spectrum of water, waste, and energy management services, including water and wastewater treatment, commercial and hazardous waste collection and disposal, energy consulting and resource recovery. Veolia helps commercial, industrial, healthcare, higher education and municipality customers throughout North America. Headquartered in Boston, Veolia has more than 10,000 employees working at more than 350 locations across North America.

 **Job Description**

**Position Purpose:**

Reporting to and assisting the Veolia Water New York, Inc. Vice President of Operations , this position is responsible for the overall management of the Production and Transmission and Distribution System (T&D) for Veolia Water Westchester, Inc. (VWWC). This individual will provide managerial oversight to the operations, maintenance and construction activities in the Production and the Transmission and Distribution (T&D) Departments to ensure the following objectives are met: departmental financials as they relate to both the budget and approved rate of returns, regulatory compliance, safety, employee development, customer experience, and continuous improvement. This individual is also responsible for managing external relations with municipal and community leaders.

* Revenue - $70 M
* Annual Budget - $32 M
* Capital Budget - $30 M
* Customers – 48,000
* Population Served – 200,000
* Direct Reports – 2 (Manager of Production and Superintendent of T&D)
* Indirect Reports – 62 (non-exempt, non-bargaining and bargaining)
* Budget Accountabilities

**Primary Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Support the Vice President of Operations of the NY Division by developing policy and strategies for VWWC, specifically non-revenue water and asset management.
* Provide direction and management to ensure that VWWC operates in compliance with updated management practices, with data and record retention for auditable trails. Ensure all staff follows Veolia policies and manuals.
* Direct all the statutory and regulatory requirements for health and safety to provide a safe and efficient place of work for our employees. Assist theVice President of the NY Division in providing customers with safe, reliable and adequate service in the most cost effective way.
* Maintain compliance with all company, governmental and/or environmental regulations and policies to provide safe potable water.
* Direct the collection of sufficient data to manage risk and make effective management decisions.
* Conduct appropriate performance reviews to drive results and demonstrate continuous improvement in water treatment, water transmission, construction and distribution.
* Participate in the preparation of accurate and realistic annual operating and capital plans. Monitor Key Performance Indicators.
* Assists in the control of operating and capital expenditures pursuant to the time and monetary schedules contained in the plans.
* Review and analyze non-revenue water statistics, determine appropriate plans and implement agreed recommendations.
* Directs the operations team to ensure the attainment of service, financial goals and major program efforts.
* Ensures the training and cross training of employees through on the job training workshops or schools, evaluation or appraisals, to equip them to perform their assigned duties efficiently and effectively.
* Oversee laboratory process including sampling and testing.
* Assist in employee and career development programs, through ongoing education, seminars and in-house training.
* Participate in labor relations issues including negotiations, grievance, and arbitrations.
* Work with the Regional President of the NY Division with respect to community relations by attending meetings with mayors and town administrators.
* Conduct special studies or analysis as requested by the Vice President of Operations of the NY Division.
* Oversees the Company's fleet maintenance and fleet leasing program.
* May provide testimony in liability and litigation cases.
* Responsible for documenting, developing and maintaining Company's "Emergency Response Plan".
* Keep current with Federal, State and local health regulations.

new_roles.title: Director Operations
new_roles.description:
**About Justrite Safety Group**

At **Justrite Safety Group**, we're more than just a collection of industrial safety companies; we're a dynamic organization dedicated to protecting people, property, and the planet. Our ever-growing portfolio of companies collaborates to deliver advanced industrial safety solutions that set the standard for excellence.

As our business continues to grow, we continue to look for top talent to join our team as we lead the charge in revolutionizing industrial safety, ensuring that every worker returns home safe, every workplace remains secure, and our environment thrives for generations to come. With Justrite Safety Group, safety isn't just a priority—it's our passion.

Temporary, off-site, and transportation-based worksites present unique safety and compliance challenges that our **Jobsite Motion Safety** division addresses with a robust range of portable, durable, and self-contained products. Our jobsite solutions include ground protection, spill containment, wheel chocks, hazardous materials storage, hazard signage, emergency response kits, and safety training resources. By tackling various aspects of jobsite safety, we empower organizations to strengthen their safety protocols, improve operational efficiency, and foster a culture of safety across all locations.

**The Contribution You'll bring to this Role:**

The **Director of Operations** will provide overall leadership and direction for the Broomfield, CO and Titusville, PA sites, ensuring excellence in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and culture. This position will oversee all functions within the facility—including manufacturing, engineering, quality, maintenance, planning, warehouse operations, and EHS—while partnering closely with HR, finance, and corporate leadership to align site performance with business objectives.

This role will drive a customer-focused, LEAN-based culture, fostering continuous improvement, operational discipline, and employee engagement throughout the organization.

In this role, you will report directly to the Chief Operating Officer, setting the stage for your career to soar! This role is your gateway to opportunities for advancement, with the potential to grow within the organization in 3-5 years as you make meaningful contributions to our organizational goals.

**About the Team:**

As a member of our **Operations** team, you will be dedicated to driving efficiency and excellence across all aspects of our business. With a focus on streamlined processes and innovative solutions, they ensure that our operations run smoothly and effectively. Comprised of skilled professionals who are leaders in their field, the team is committed to optimizing performance and delivering high-quality results. Their expertise is key to maintaining our competitive edge and supporting the growth and success of our company.

**What You'll Do at Justrite:**

**Operational Leadership**

* Lead all site operations, ensuring performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity meet or exceed expectations.

* Oversee and develop direct reports including Production, Maintenance, Engineering, Planning, Warehouse, and Quality leaders.

* Establish both short- and long-term operational strategies aligned with corporate objectives and sales forecasts.

* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and use data-driven decision-making to improve efficiency, throughput, and service levels.

**Continuous Improvement & LEAN Transformation**

* Champion LEAN manufacturing principles and culture across all departments.

* Drive standardization, waste elimination, and process improvement through engagement at every level.

* Lead kaizen events and ensure visual management and accountability systems are in place.

**Safety, Health, and Environment**

* Foster a proactive, safety-first culture ensuring compliance with all OSHA, EPA, and local environmental regulations.

* Lead site EHS initiatives to promote a safe, clean, and sustainable work environment.

**People & Culture**

* Build and develop a high-performing leadership team, ensuring succession planning and career development opportunities.

* Promote open communication, teamwork, and accountability.

* Partner with HR to support employee engagement, retention, and organizational development.

**Financial & Strategic Accountability**

* Prepare and manage annual operating and capital budgets, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.

* Drive cost reduction and productivity initiatives while maintaining quality and service standards.

* Participate in strategic planning and contribute to broader business initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for corporate and business unit leaders on all site-related activities.

* Collaborate with supply chain, quality, finance, HR, and engineering teams to ensure alignment on priorities and resource allocation.

* Represent the site in business reviews and support corporate-level projects and new product launches.

**Your Skills and Expertise:**

To ensure your success from day one in this role, Justrite requires the following qualifications at a minimum:

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum of 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing operations, preferably with exposure to Reaction Injection Molding (RIM), Rigid and Integral Skin Foam, and open cast molding.
* Proven track record of LEAN leadership and cultural transformation in a manufacturing setting.
* Strong understanding of cost systems, production planning, quality management, maintenance, and safety programs.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, foster collaboration, and develop future leaders.

*Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:*

* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams); ERP system experience preferred.

**Compensation:**

The position offers a competitive base salary ranging from $160,000 to $200,000.

Actual base salaries will vary and may be above or below the recommended pay range based on factors such as but not limited to location, relevant experience and performance. Additionally, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan to enhance their overall total compensation package when Justrite Safety Group and their business units achieve annual business and financial targets.

 
Compensation: 140,000 to 165,000

new_roles.description:
Description:

**Come Join the Toledo Tool & Die Team!**

Located close to the Michigan/Ohio border, Toledo Tool and Die has diligently served the people of both of those great states since 1940. It was a company founded on one simple principle: to do the finest work possible for our clients and to deliver on every promise we make. Today Toledo Tool & Die has four facilities in the Toledo area and one in Pioneer, Ohio.

Toledo Tool & Die is looking for a **Plant Manager** to join our team to support our continued growth.

This is a full-time position based in Toledo, Ohio. We offer competitive wages, growth opportunities, and a clean, safe work environment.

**WHAT TOLEDO TOOL & DIE CAN OFFER YOU:**

* Weekly pay
* 10 paid holidays
* 401k
* Full benefits

**WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT FOR THIS POSITION:**

* Previous experience at the plant manager level or equivalent
* Strong work ethic
* Positive attitude
* Consistent attendance
* Willingness to learn
* Safety minded

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, direction, and operational performance of an automotive manufacturing facility. This role ensures the plant meets or exceeds expectations for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and employee engagement while driving continuous improvement and operational excellence. The Plant Manager provides strategic leadership to all plant functions—including Production, Quality, Maintenance, Engineering, Materials, HR, and EHS—ensuring alignment with organizational goals and customer requirements. This position plays a critical role in developing a high-performing culture, optimizing manufacturing processes, growing talent, and ensuring the long-term success and competitiveness of the facility.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Provide overall leadership and accountability for plant operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production across robotic assembly, and related processes.
* Establish and execute plant strategies focused on safety performance, customer satisfaction, financial targets, operational efficiency, and workforce development.
* Lead, mentor, and develop department managers, supervisors, and cross-functional teams to drive a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and high performance.
* Ensure compliance with safety policies, regulatory requirements, and environmental standards while actively promoting a world-class safety culture.
* Oversee adherence to IATF 16949, ISO, customer-specific requirements, and internal quality standards; partner with Quality to address issues and implement corrective actions.
* Monitor and manage plant KPIs including OEE, scrap, uptime, throughput, labor efficiency, and cost performance; ensure action plans are in place to address underperformance.
* Partner with Maintenance and Engineering to ensure equipment reliability, effective PM programs, and timely response to downtime or tooling issues.
* Oversee Materials/Logistics operations including inventory accuracy, material flow, scheduling, shipping, and customer delivery performance.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives, waste elimination efforts, standardized work implementation, and continuous improvement projects throughout the facility.
* Champion 5S, workplace organization, and visual factory standards across all production areas.
* Develop and manage annual plant budgets, capital expenditures, and long-term investment strategies.
* Collaborate with corporate leadership on production planning, capacity analysis, new program launches, engineering changes, and customer development initiatives.
* Ensure organizational compliance with HR, labor, ethics, and employment practices, including respect for human rights, non-discriminatory treatment, proper working hours, and wage law compliance.
* Build a positive employee relations environment through strong communication, coaching, and recognition; address workforce concerns and support effective engagement strategies.
* Lead regular plant meetings to ensure alignment, transparency, and effective communication across all levels of the organization.
* Represent the facility with customers, suppliers, auditors, and corporate partners.
* Employee is responsible for ensuring all environmental practices are in line with job scope / position. Examples include but not limited to: proper waste disposal practices, reporting of spills, non-compliance to permit, and addressing any improper practices.
* Employee is responsible for ensuring all human resources, ethics, and labor policies and practices are carried out in accordance with company policy and as in line with the scope of the position. Examples include but are not limited to: respecting the human rights of all workers (prohibition of forced labor, no child labor, maintaining appropriate working hours, and non-discriminatory treatment of all workers), abiding by ethical standards such as zero tolerance for bribery, corruption, extortion, and embezzlement, maintaining appropriate working hours of employees along with ensuring compensation is paid to workers that complies with all applicable wage laws.
* Assumes additional duties as assigned, which may fall outside the primary scope of the role.

**ISO / ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (EMS) RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensure that the resources needed for the environmental management system are available.
* Communicate the importance of effective environmental management and of conforming to the environmental management system requirements.
* Ensure that the environmental management system achieves its intended outcomes.
* Direct and support persons to contribute to the effectiveness of the environmental management system.

Requirements:

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, Industrial Technology, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* 10–15 years of progressive manufacturing experience with at least 5 years in a leadership role; automotive robotic assembly experience strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of managing large teams, complex manufacturing operations, and high-volume production environments.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong understanding of automotive quality systems, including IATF 16949 and ISO standards.
* Demonstrated success improving plant performance, reducing costs, and driving operational excellence.

**GENERAL SKILLS/EXPERIENCE:**

* Strong leadership presence with the ability to inspire, influence, and motivate teams.
* Excellent communication skills for interacting with employees at all levels, customers, and executive leadership.
* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.
* Ability to build a culture of trust, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

**SOFTWARE/COMPUTER SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Experience with ERP or MES systems such as SAP, Oracle, Plex, QAD, or similar manufacturing platforms.
* Ability to interpret data dashboards, KPIs, and operational reports to guide decision-making.
* Demonstrated proficiency with digital tools used for production reporting, labor tracking, and quality management.
