existing_roles.title: Plant/Manufacturing Director
existing_roles.description:
Job Summary
 
Maker’s Pride is seeking a proven, enterprise-minded Plant Director to lead our largest manufacturing facility in McComb, Ohio, a site of more than 1,600 Team Members that is critical to the success of our business. The Plant Director holds full accountability for the safety, quality, service, cost, and people performance of a large-scale co-manufacturing operation, and serves as the senior leader on site and the face of the plant to customers, Team Members, and the community.
 
This role requires a seasoned operations executive who has led large, complex plants of 1,000+ Team Members, can build and develop a strong leadership bench, and can balance day-to-day execution with long-term strategy. The Plant Director partners closely with senior leadership and corporate functions to deliver the plant’s operating plan, drive operational excellence, and position McComb for sustained growth.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 

* Operational Leadership: Lead all plant operations, including production, packaging, maintenance, engineering, quality, warehouse, and supply chain, to consistently deliver safety, quality, service, and cost targets across multiple shifts and lines.
* P&L and Financial Accountability: Own the plant’s operating plan, budget, and financial performance, including labor, overtime, yield, waste, and capital spend. Identify and execute cost-reduction and margin-improvement opportunities.
* Strategic Planning: Develop and execute a multi-year plant strategy aligned to enterprise goals, covering capacity, capital investment, automation, new business onboarding, and talent.
* Production Planning and Capacity: Partner with Supply Chain, Planning, and Customer teams to build production schedules and resource plans that optimize throughput, labor utilization, and on-time, in-full performance.
* Quality and Food Safety: Ensure strict adherence to quality, food safety, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, GMP, HACCP, and customer and third-party audit standards). Drive corrective and preventive actions and maintain audit readiness at all times.
* Safety Culture: Champion a zero-harm culture. Enforce safety policies, lead regular audits and incident reviews, and hold the leadership team accountable for proactive hazard prevention and compliance.
* Workforce Strategy and Labor Relations: Partner with HR to attract, retain, and engage a large and diverse workforce. Drive staffing stability, reduce turnover, manage overtime effectively, and foster positive Team Member and labor relations, including compliance with applicable employment and labor laws and agreements.
* Customer and Partner Relationships: Serve as the senior site representative with co-manufacturing customers, hosting visits and audits, resolving escalations, and building long-term trust. Collaborate with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of materials and finished goods.
* Continuous Improvement: Lead a data-driven operational excellence program using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies to eliminate waste, improve OEE and yield, and standardize best practices across shifts.
* Capital and Asset Management: Oversee capital planning, project execution, and asset reliability to ensure equipment, infrastructure, and facilities support safe, efficient, and scalable operations.
* Reporting and Executive Communication: Provide regular, transparent reporting on safety, quality, production, financial, and workforce KPIs to senior leadership, with clear analysis, risks, and recommendations.
* Community and Site Presence: Represent Maker’s Pride in the McComb community and maintain a visible, accessible leadership presence on the plant floor across all shifts.

Supervisory Responsibilities
 

* Leadership of a Large Organization: Provide direct leadership to the plant leadership team and overall leadership of 1,600+ Team Members, including managers, supervisors, technicians, and support staff.
* Talent Development: Build a strong leadership bench through coaching, performance management, succession planning, and development of high-potential leaders.
* Culture and Accountability: Foster a culture of safety, quality, teamwork, accountability, respect, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications
 

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field required; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
* Experience: 15+ years of progressive manufacturing operations experience, including 7+ years in a senior plant leadership role (Plant Manager, Plant Director, or equivalent).
* Scale: Demonstrated success leading large, complex, multi-shift plants of 1,000+ Team Members, with full P&L accountability.
* Industry: Experience in co-manufacturing, food, beverage, or other high-volume, regulated manufacturing environments strongly preferred.
* Operational Excellence: Track record of delivering measurable improvements in safety, quality, productivity, and cost. Lean, Six Sigma, or similar certification desirable.
* Workforce Leadership: Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop a large, diverse workforce, including strong experience with staffing, retention, and employee and labor relations. Experience in a unionized environment is a plus.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, food safety and quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Technology: Proficiency in ERP systems and Microsoft Office Suite; experience with manufacturing software (e.g., SAP, Oracle) is a plus.
* Leadership Skills: Strategic thinker with excellent executive presence, communication, and decision-making skills; able to influence at all levels of the organization and with customers.
* Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a focus on data-driven decision-making.

The information provided in this document provides an overview of the most common duties, qualifications, and demands of the position. It is not intended to be a comprehensive summary of the role, and the duties, qualifications, and demands of the position are subject to change without notice. The expectations provided here may also be modified if an employee with a disability could effectively meet the expectations for the role with reasonable accommodation.

existing_roles.title: Director of Program Management, Manufacturing
existing_roles.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

KRUSH Tech is an international technology company developing advanced hardware solutions for defense, aerospace, communications, and autonomous systems. We're launching our U.S. operations from the ground up, building a next-generation, vertically integrated aerospace organization focused on advanced uncrewed aircraft systems (UAS), autonomy, and sensing technologies for the U.S. market and strategic partners. Our teams work across RF, embedded systems, electronics, mechanical engineering, software, manufacturing, and supply chain to turn some of the industry's most demanding engineering challenges into reliable, production-ready solutions, combining the agility of a startup with the ambition to compete at the leading edge of UAS and autonomous systems.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Director of Program Management to lead program delivery for KRUSH's uncrewed aircraft systems, from development through production and fielding. This senior leadership role owns cost, schedule, and technical delivery performance across a portfolio of cross-functional programs, aligns engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and test around clear milestones, and serves as the point of accountability for customers and partners.

Reporting to the Vice President of Manufacturing Operations, you will build program management discipline in a start-up U.S. operation: light enough to move fast, and rigorous enough to meet customer commitments. You will partner closely with engineering and manufacturing leaders to take products from concept through production ramp, balancing competing priorities, risks, and resources across programs.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Own cost, schedule, scope, and technical delivery performance across a portfolio of programs, from development through production and fielding
* Develop and implement program management strategy, governance, and standards, using lightweight processes and tools that fit a fast-moving start-up
* Ensure programs align with corporate objectives and strategic priorities, and lead portfolio reviews that prioritize initiatives by business value and strategic impact
* Build, lead, and develop the program management team as the organization grows, including career development and succession planning
* Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Test leaders to drive decisions, manage dependencies, and resolve issues across functions
* Lead the transition of programs from development into production, including readiness reviews and stage-gate decisions
* Manage portfolio resource allocation, monitor program performance and interdependencies, and balance competing priorities
* Serve as the primary interface with customers, executive leadership, and external partners, communicating program status, risks, opportunities, and outcomes, and facilitating steering committees and executive reviews
* Develop and manage program budgets and forecasts, monitor financial performance, evaluate business cases and return on investment, and support annual planning and investment prioritization
* Identify, assess, and mitigate program risks and issues, and develop contingency plans for critical risks
* Lead change management and organizational readiness activities for program changes
* Ensure compliance with governance, regulatory, export control, and contractual requirements
* Implement program and portfolio management tools and reporting systems, and define and track program KPIs, including on-time milestone achievement, budget adherence, resource utilization, and risk mitigation effectiveness
* Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, and delivery excellence

 **Requirements**

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field
* 10+ years of program and project management experience, preferably in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability hardware
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing large programs or a PMO function
* Experience leading cross-functional, hardware-intensive programs from development through production
* Experience managing programs under customer or government contracts, including cost, schedule, and deliverable performance
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional strategic initiatives and to influence executive stakeholders
* Strong skills in program and portfolio management, strategic planning, financial and budget management, risk and issue management, change management, and resource planning
* Strong data analysis and executive reporting skills, with experience in business process improvement
* Strong leadership, negotiation, and influencing skills
* Active U.S. Secret security clearance, with the ability to maintain it
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 50% of the time
* Must qualify as a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities (ITAR)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Master's degree (MBA or equivalent)
* Familiarity with defense contracting and acquisition processes, including FAR/DFARS, contract types, CDRLs, and earned value management
* Experience building a program management function or PMO at a start-up or high-growth company
* PMP or an equivalent program management certification

 **Benefits**

KRUSH Tech offers a competitive compensation package. Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual offers are determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on interview performance, job-related skills, relevant education and experience, certifications, and internal equity.

The salary range provided is a good faith estimate of the applicable range as of the date of posting. The final offer will be determined after considering all relevant factors, including a candidate's qualifications and experience.

In addition to base pay, KRUSH Tech offers a monthly benefits stipend that employees can apply toward the health, dental, vision, or other coverage that best fits their needs, along with 9 paid federal holidays per year.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

KRUSH Tech is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

**Reasonable Accommodation Statement**

KRUSH Tech is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and hiring process and during employment. If you require assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact Human Resources.

**Join Komatsu and Be Part of Something Big!**

**Job Overview**
----------------

Planning, organizing, leading and controlling all manufacturing related activities of TimberPro Inc. (TPI). Responsible for the performance of departmental functions: Manufacturing, Materials Management, Quality Assurance, Production Planning, CapEx Planning, Human Resources, Facilities Management and supporting Manufacturing Engineering.

**Key Job Responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Develops, reviews, and approves operating plans to achieve production and financial objectives, with accountability for budget control, labor and material efficiency, customer service, order fulfillment, employee relations, and effective workforce utilization.
* Manages Material Resource Planning (MRP), including inventory planning, accuracy, control, and optimization. Coordinates with major suppliers to ensure accurate forecasting, appropriate inventory levels, and reliable component availability to meet production requirements and future capacity expansion.
* Monitors performance against operating plans and standards, communicates results, identifies areas requiring corrective action, and recommends adjustments to achieve operational objectives.
* Develops and presents monthly performance reports as requested by Executive management.
* Develops and implements local policies and procedures consistent with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, OSHA standards, and Komatsu safety requirements, ensuring compliance and a strong safety culture.
* Establishes plant operating objectives and develops short- and long-term plans, budgets, financial forecasts, and resource requirements to achieve business goals.
* Provides oversight for plant cost control, cost forecasting, workforce planning, and facility and capacity requirements, identifying risks and implementing actions to achieve operational and financial objectives.
* Reviews and approves the development and review of all TPI manufacturing budgets.
* Manages facility contracts and third-party service providers, including material disposal, plant and facility maintenance, uniforms, and other site services, ensuring cost, service, and compliance performance.
* Oversees plant budgeting, reviews departmental budget proposals, monitors spending, and authorizes expenditures within established approval limits.
* Reviews and approves major projects involving functional changes within TPI.
* Leads identification and implementation of new manufacturing technologies, automation, processes, and capabilities supporting TimberPro’s long-term operational strategy. Collaborates across Komatsu manufacturing operations to leverage best practices, technical expertise, and solutions that drive improvement in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.
* Consults with management responsible for policy or action, ensures compliance within areas of responsibility, and recommends improvements to policies and procedures.
* Establishes objectives and procedures governing assigned activities. Issues annual objectives to immediate subordinates and reviews objectives of TPI management.
* Builds and maintains an effective plant leadership team through selection, development, coaching, and retention of qualified personnel. Ensures clear roles, responsibilities, and accountability and supports compensation, training, performance management, and succession planning.
* Leads and evaluates direct reports, coordinates activities across functions, identifies training and development needs, and takes appropriate personnel actions to ensure organizational performance.
* Maintains effective communication with employees at all plant levels, providing clear direction, timely feedback, and visibility to business priorities and operational performance.
* Ensures coordination across plant functions and other company organizations, resolving cross-functional issues related to new product development, workers’ compensation, inventory control, and operational performance.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications/Requirements**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree Manufacturing, Engineering or Business Required. MBA or Masters in Engineering or Manufacturing preferred.
* Minimum 3 years’ experience as a GM of Operations in Manufacturing or similar experience.
* Sound administrative skills, well-developed management skills – principles and people.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate across all functions of the organization.
* Working experience in union and non-union environments.
* Experience with Material Management – Bills of Materials, Sourcing, Purchasing, and Inventory Management.
* Experience with new product development and transitioning those products into production.
* Proven ability to recruit, train, and motivate personnel in order to gain profitability and strengthen the organization.
* Honest and trustworthy toward all members of the organization. Use discretion on matters of confidentiality.
* Portray an optimistic and positive attitude in dealings with peers and subordinates.

**Company Benefits**

Komatsu provides an extensive and robust employee benefits package that is designed to enhance the well-being of our employees and family members. We embrace a positive and empowering employee experience with a culture that prides itself on a diverse and inclusive environment.

* Health benefits: Medical, dental, vision, HSA, wellness programs, etc.
* 401k and/or employee savings programs
* Employee time off (vacation and designated holidays)
* Employee and family assistance programs
* Disability benefits
* Life insurance
* Employee learning and development programs

**Diversity & Inclusion Commitment**

At Komatsu, we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We are committed to creating a workforce that is reflective of the communities we work and live in. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose. Connected by our core values of ambition, perseverance, collaboration and authenticity, we are committed to continually advancing in our support of diversity and inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together.

**Company Information**

Komatsu develops and supplies technologies, equipment and services for the construction, mining, forklift, industrial and forestry markets. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu employs more than 64,000 people worldwide, operating in more than 140 countries. For more than a century, the company has been creating value for its customers through manufacturing and technology innovation, partnering with others to empower a sustainable future where people, business and the planet thrive together. Since the company’s founding in 1921, Komatsu has been committed to supporting individuals and communities through job training, skills development and giving back. As a Komatsu employee, you will be encouraged to grow alongside our global company, contributing to a more sustainable future for all. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, join Komatsu to be a part of something big and help advance modern society. Learn more at www.komatsu.com.

**EEO Statement**

Komatsu is an Equal Opportunity Workplace and an Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Manufacturing Plant Manager to lead day-to-day operations within a small to mid-sized manufacturing and fabrication environment. This individual will be responsible for driving production performance, developing and managing teams, improving processes, maintaining safety standards, and ensuring the plant meets operational and business objectives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in assembly, steel components, fabrication, welding, or HVAC manufacturing, along with a proven track record of leadership and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee daily plant operations, including production, assembly, fabrication, welding, and related manufacturing activities.
* Provide leadership, direction, and accountability to supervisors, production employees, and support teams.
* Develop and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure productivity, quality, safety, efficiency, and overall plant performance.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement solutions that improve productivity, quality, and profitability.
* Lead teams through organizational and operational changes while maintaining productivity and employee engagement.
* Work cross-functionally with other departments to coordinate production priorities, schedules, resources, and deadlines.
* Establish clear expectations and hold supervisors and employees accountable for performance.
* Develop supervisors and team members through coaching, training, and performance management.
* Ensure compliance with plant safety policies, procedures, training requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Coordinate and oversee safety-related activities, inspections, training, and corrective actions.
* Prepare accurate operational reports and maintain records related to production, safety, inspections, quality, and performance.
* Conduct and participate in production meetings, safety meetings, and operational reviews.
* Manage competing priorities and respond effectively to changing production demands and deadlines.
* Utilize technology and business systems to support plant operations, reporting, scheduling, and planning.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to overall plant strategy and business objectives.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Industrial Management, Manufacturing Management, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant industry experience will be considered.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

Eaton's Electrical Sector Americas - ARS/Fibrebond division is currently seeking a Plant Manager for its manufacturing operations in Minden, Louisiana. This role is a critical member of the site leadership team and is responsible for leading safe, high-quality, on-time, and cost-effective operations. Relocation assistance is available to candidates currently residing in the U.S. 
 
In this role, you will lead the Minden manufacturing site and its leadership team. You will drive strategic and operational initiatives including plant P&L, growth strategy, capacity, execution, and the direction of the team to meet and exceed short- and long-term business goals. You will foster an environment of engagement and inclusion for all employees and act with advocacy, empathy, and accountability. 
 
Fibrebond, an Eaton company, designs and manufactures pre-integrated modular buildings and power enclosures that protect mission-critical equipment for data center, industrial, utility, and communications customers. Headquartered in Minden, Louisiana, Fibrebond is known for its engineered-to-order solutions that support complex infrastructure projects across North America. In 2025, Fibrebond was acquired by Eaton, expanding Eaton's modular solutions portfolio while preserving Fibrebond's strong engineering expertise, customer focus, and manufacturing operations in Louisiana. 
 
**What you’ll need:** 

* Develop short- and long-term plans in alignment with the strategic plan and annual profit plan objectives to drive superior operational performance and financial results.
* Lead the operational management team and functional staff including Quality, OPEX, EHS and Supply Chain.
* Establish objectives and drive Key Performance Indicators across the organization ensuring continuous improvement.
* Emphasize utilization of Lean/Six Sigma manufacturing tools (Kaizen, VSM, 5S+) to lead cost improvement
* Establish and manage inventory to profit plan, driving improved and sustainable processes; execute the Supply Demand Planning (SIOP), drive ownership and collaboration across all stakeholder groups; generate forecasts that meet customer expectations.
* Champion a workplace focused on Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) to drive a zero-incident safety culture.
* Focus on Quality, early detection and escalations across the site to reduce cost, drive efficiency and ensure compliance.
* Create a culture of exceeding customer expectations, ensuring that the organization is highly responsive to customer needs.
* Demonstrate the ability to be innovative by developing and implementing creative solutions to complex problems, fostering a culture of innovation and continuously seeking opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with Human Resources to drive talent management, learning, communication, and development strategies.
* Champion and advocate for a winning plant culture aligned with the Eaton Culture Model

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Required Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution
* 10+ years of experience with progressive levels of accountability and responsibility in roles focused on manufacturing, supply chain, finance, OPEX and/or related support functions in a manufacturing environment.
* 5+ years of people-management experience
* Must be able to travel as business needs require.
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position.This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

 
**Preferred Qualifications:** 

* MBA from an accredited institution
* Previous experience leading a complex engineered-to-order manufacturing operation through growth, capacity expansion, operational transformation.
* Plant P&L leadership experience with strong business acumen.
* 3+ years of experience as a leader of leaders.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

* This role will be based at our Fibrebond manufacturing plant in Minden, LA.
* Relocation will be offered for this position.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.*

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.

existing_roles.description:
* **️****Join Power Electronics and Be Part of the Shift Toward a Sustainable Future**

**About Power Electronics**

At Power Electronics, we believe in a cleaner, more efficient, and sustainable future driven by technological innovation. We are global leaders in renewable energy and power electronics, with a presence in over 36 countries and a team of more than 3,000 professionals united by a single purpose: transforming energy into progress.

Every day, we design solutions that drive change toward a more responsible world—for the planet and for future generations.

**Misión del puesto**

Liderar la puesta en marcha y la operación diaria de la nueva planta de Power Electronics en Houston, replicando el modelo productivo, los estándares de calidad y la cultura de Power Electronics, y asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos QCDP (Quality, Cost, Delivery, People) durante la rampa de producción.

**Responsabilidades principales**

**Arranque de planta y rampa de producción**

 

* Participar en la puesta en marcha de la planta con los equipos de ingeniería, facilities y logística.
* Replicar en Houston los procesos, estándares y rutinas de gestión de las plantas de España.
* Definir la estructura organizativa de producción y el plan de dimensionamiento de plantilla hasta 2028.
* Asegurar que la capacidad productiva crece según el plan de rampa, identificando cuellos de botella y riesgos.

**Gestión operativa**

* Asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de calidad, coste, entrega y personas.
* Gestionar recursos entre líneas/centros de coste según la carga productiva.
* Controlar los KPIs de planta (productividad, eficiencia, calidad, entrega, absentismo, seguridad, coste) y definir planes de acción correctivos y preventivos.
* Seguimiento diario de desviaciones en producción, testeo y entrega.

**Personas y liderazgo**

* Participar activamente en la selección de operarios, supervisores y mandos intermedios, junto con Talento y el partner local de staffing.
* Liderar, formar y desarrollar supervisores y mandos intermedios; construir una cultura de responsabilidad, autonomía, cercanía y mejora continua.
* Integrar a una plantilla diversa y mayoritariamente de nueva incorporación; asegurar el onboarding y la formación técnica.

**Mejora continua y Lean**

* Implantar y consolidar Lean Manufacturing desde el diseño: 5S, flujo continuo, Kanban, VSM, estandarización, gestión visual y rutinas diarias.

**Seguridad y cumplimiento**

* Garantizar el cumplimiento de la normativa de seguridad y salud laboral de US (OSHA) y de las políticas del grupo.
* Asegurar el cumplimiento de la normativa laboral estadounidense aplicable en la gestión de personas, en coordinación con HR

**Perfil requerido**

**Formación**

* Ingeniería Industrial, Mecánica, Electrónica, Organización Industrial o formación técnica equivalente.
* Valorable: Lean / Six Sigma (Green o Black Belt), gestión de operaciones, prevención de riesgos laborales.

**Experiencia**

* Mínimo 8 años en entornos productivos, con al menos 5 en posiciones de Plant Manager, Director/Jefe de Producción u Operaciones.
* Experiencia liderando plantillas amplias (idealmente 100+ personas) con supervisores y mandos intermedios.
* Valorable: arranque de plantas (greenfield) o rampas de producción.
* Implantación de Lean Manufacturing y gestión por KPIs.
* Valorable: experiencia en EE.UU. y conocimiento de su normativa laboral y de seguridad (OSHA).

**Idiomas**

* Español e inglés a nivel profesional (imprescindibles ambos).

**Movilidad y requisitos**

* Disponibilidad para residir en Houston y para estancias y viajes a España.

existing_roles.description:
Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re all about propelling the next generation of leaders forward. We are driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future. We deliver innovative solutions that make our customers’ lives easier—helping them power, protect, and intelligently manage their homes and businesses. To do this, we need creative and talented people to join our company.

We offer a dynamic work environment and a unified and inclusive culture. NRG fosters a strong sense of belonging that leads to better collaboration and business performance. Our company programs are designed to help employees develop the skills they need for success now and in the future. In everything we do, we aim to champion our employees and bring value to our customers, investors and society.

More information is available at www.nrg.com. Connect with NRG on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and X.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Responsible for all aspects of Plant Operation and Maintenance, including P&L responsibility. Responsible for maintaining a competent, well-trained staff. Responsible for plant safety, training, environmental compliance, policy administration and has purchasing authority for required materials and services. Maintain good relationship with customers and the community. Responsible for supporting and executing Gas Plant Strategy in a dynamic financial climate. The Aurora and Rockford Generating simple cycle peaking plants are located outside of Chicago. Aurora Generation is a 1000 MW facility operating four GE 7FAs and six GE LM 6000 natural gas-fired combustion turbines. Rockford Generation is a 540MW facility operating three Siemens V84.3A2 natural gas-fired combustion turbines. The two sites are about 70 miles apart.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Supports and emphasizes importance of safety and environmental programs and ensures regulatory compliance
* Promotes productivity and teamwork with open communication, timely decision making, and use of leadership skills to set high standards of performance, while providing the direction necessary to achieve performance
* Promotes and supports the development of technical leadership and business skills of employees to carry out responsibilities in a competitive environment
* Responsible for matrix communications to NRG management
* Provides regular feedback to employees on their performance to allow them to capitalize on their strengths and focus on opportunities for improvement
* Creates and supports an organizational culture that encourages and rewards employee involvement, innovative thinking, adaptation to change, responsible risk taking, customer focus, and continuous improvement
* Formulates appropriate strategies which support the overall NRG strategy and manages development, implementation and execution of assigned area goals, objectives, and initiatives
* Manages all business aspects of assigned area to maximize competitive position of the plant including operational performance, staff development and cost management
* Reviews organizational performance with constituents and addresses opportunities for improvement on a regular basis
* Manages, as necessary, the evaluation and selection of external service providers.
* Manages work performed by external service providers in support of organizational objectives and responsibilities
* Assigns work and holds employees accountable for their performance
* Develops and maintains professional relationships with organizations external to the plant
* Ensures that appropriate technical expertise related to assigned area of responsibility is available and provided to employees in a timely manner.
* Manages development and execution of appropriate standards, guidelines, programs, and procedures within assigned area of responsibility
* Uses and maintains technical and professional knowledge, shares that knowledge with others, and recognizes/applies new technology in a cost-effective manner
* Obtains and applies knowledge of competitive business practices in daily work activities and decision making
* Seeks and understands the organizational needs and focuses on meeting and exceeding these requirements
* Anticipates, accepts and successfully implements necessary changes in the organization and adapts to meet the new requirements
* Ensure a safe and environmentally compliant workplace
* Willing to accept accountability for own decisions, performance, and behavior, as well as the performance of assigned staff
* Must be able to effectively interface with regulatory, political, business, civic and public representatives consistent with NRG corporate objectives

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Minimum of Bachelors degree in an Engineering or related technical discipline, and 10 years of equivalent experience in a related technical field; or a minimum of 14 years experience in a related technical field or similar position
* Demonstrated record of successfully leading/supervising employees in a related field
* Ability to split time between both sites

**Preferred:**

* Experience with GE 7FA, LM6000 and/or Siemens V84.3A2 preferred.
* Experience with remote operations a plus. Aurora responsible for the remote operation of 8 LM6000s in Texas at 4 different sites.

**Competencies:**
-----------------

* Uses and maintains technical and professional knowledge, shares that knowledge with others, and recognizes/applies new technology in a cost effective manner
* Obtains and applies knowledge of competitive business practices in daily work activities and decision making
* Seeks and understands the customer/client’s needs and focuses on meeting and exceeding their expectations
* Anticipates and accepts changes in the organization and adapts to meet the new requirements
* Committed to making the workplace safe and environmentally sound
* Willing to accept accountability for own decisions, performance, and behavior, as well as the performance of assigned employees.

**Working Conditions:**
-----------------------

* Power plant environment.
* Requires operation of a motor vehicle; active Driver’s License.
* Work overtime and non-standard working hours as required
* Requires occasional travel outside service area
* Requires wearing personal protective safety equipment (respirators, safety glasses, hard hat, appropriate footwear, ear plugs, etc.)
* Required to work around rotating and energized equipment, hazardous materials and chemicals
* Requires standing, sitting, walking, kneeling, twisting, climbing stairs and ladders, and entering plant equipment.
* Requires operation of a personal computer
* Occasionally requires lifting as appropriate to perform duties and responsibilities

Actual salaries will vary based on several factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. In addition the position may be eligible to participate in the benefits program which include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending accounts.

**JOB SUMMARY**: The Plant Manager is responsible for translating and implementing operating strategies to ensure that all plant operations meet or exceed organizational goals and objectives.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS (COMPETENCIES)**:

* Build, lead and manage a plant management team
* Ensure that the facility and personnel are operating in compliance with all applicable state, federal and local regulations
* Lead/support new process planning, design, build, start-up and operation
* Implement and manage change within the facility
* Serve as a strategic partner with corporate management and provide input on long- and short-term staffing levels, plant improvements, design and layout, and capital purchases
* Conduct financial planning and budgeting activities as required or requested
* Create purchase requisitions and approve purchase orders up to level of authority
* Promote LEAN manufacturing principles
* Conduct management review of quality systems, ensure compliance, and drive continuous improvement actions
* Establish lead times for customer orders and on-time delivery performance goals
* Actively participate in problem-solving activities with customers, suppliers and partners
* Advance superior performance across all production-related key performance indicators
* Implement and maintain preventive maintenance programs
* Perform the job functions of Senior Virtual Factory Manager and/or Virtual Factory Manager as needed
* Exercise the authority to stop (shutdown) any manufacturing process/facility machinery that has the potential to threaten employee safety, create an environmental/regulatory hazard or jeopardize product quality
* Perform other duties or special projects as assigned

**REQUIREMENTS**:

* Bachelor's degree in engineering preferred; 6 years related work experience in manufacturing management required; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered
* Good oral and written communication skills
* Experience in leadership and management roles
* Project management experience
* Experience with conflict management
* Demonstrated ability to manage change
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Working knowledge of business financial statements
* Computer skills including working knowledge of Microsoft Office
* Provide own source of transportation for any local/day travel, including travel between Indium Corporation facilities

**SHIFT/LOCATION:**

Monday-Friday/ 8:00am-5:00pm/ 111 Business Park Drive, Utica, NY

The salary range indicated in this posting represents the minimum and maximum of the range for the position. **Company Description**

With over $2B in revenue, 80+ manufacturing facilities across 6 continents and over 9,000 employees worldwide, Signode is a leading manufacturer of a broad spectrum of transit packaging consumables, tools, software, and equipment that optimize end-of-line packaging operations and protect products in transit. Signode brings this extensive product portfolio together under hundreds of trusted brands to offer complete transit packaging solutions to its customers. 
 
We produce strap, stretch and protective packaging. We also manufacture packaging tools and equipment used to apply the bulk packaging materials. These commercial packaging products are used to pack, bundle, unitize, protect, and secure goods during warehousing and transit. Our company is a pioneer in the industrial packaging sector with a long history of customer-focused innovations in materials, processes and automation technology that have revolutionized the sector. 
 
Headquartered in Tampa, Florida, we are proud to be the Transit Packaging Division of Crown Holdings, Inc. We are excited to go to market as Signode and to share the portfolio of products, services and capabilities that make us the world’s premier end-of-line packaging company.

 **Job Description**

**Benefits:**

Signode offers a comprehensive benefits package to full-time employees, which includes health, dental, vision, 401k, paid time off, life insurance, wellness perks, and more. Benefits begin the month following the hire date.

**Summary**

This role is for a Plant Manager who is a true leader, one who can build a strong, positive culture throughout the plant. The position calls for a sharp operational and analytical mind that constantly seeks out, teaches, and leads improvements in Safety Performance, Cost Control, Standardized Processes (LEAN), Production Reporting, and Inventory Control.

This is a high-visibility opportunity to lead one of Signode’s most important locations, having a big impact on our ability to deliver a profitable year. Here is what makes this role stand out:

* Pilot the company’s Operational Excellence system, delivering a glidepath in Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Output, and Morale.
* Take charge of a major turnaround facility. The right leader is confident yet humble, ready to run a 24/7 site from the bottom up, and understands the sweat and equity required to turn it around.
* Succeed here, and fast-track your path to the next level.

**Essential Functions**

* Directly manage and coordinate the activities of various plant departments and sites within Signode.
* Provide strong leadership to the manufacturing team, fostering a collaborative and results-oriented work environment.
* Develop and implement strategic plans to achieve production goals, optimize processes, and enhance overall plant efficiency.
* Communicate, uphold and enforce safety protocols and regulatory compliance to maintain a safe and secure working environment.
* Responsible for talent management and employee lifecycle activities, from hiring to terminating.
* Collaborate with senior management to align plant operations with organizational objectives.
* Monitor and analyze production metrics, ensuring that production targets are met while maintaining high-quality standards.
* Implement efficiency improvement initiatives and address any bottlenecks or issues in the production process.
* Efficiently allocate resources, including manpower and equipment, to meet production schedules and deadlines.
* Collaborate with the maintenance team to ensure optimal functionality of machinery and equipment.
* Collaborate with the quality control department to ensure that products meet or exceed quality standards.
* Implement measures to address any deviations or non-conformities in the production process.
* Develop and manage budgets for the manufacturing facility(s), controlling costs and optimizing resource utilization.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and implement measures to improve overall plant profitability.
* Effectively communicate with senior management, department heads, and front-line staff to ensure clear understanding of goals and objectives.
* Prepare regular reports on plant performance, production metrics, and other relevant KPIs.
* Lead and support initiatives for continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to enhance plant processes, reduce waste, and increase overall efficiency.

 
**Qualifications**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Management, Business, or Engineering. Masters Degree in similar field preferred.

**Experience:** Minimum of 15+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, with at least 5 -7 years in a managerial or supervisory role. **Previous experience as a plant manager is a must.**

* Financial Acumen with the ability to analyze and forecast data and translate results to better solutions. With the understanding of general ledger accounting and activity rate costing.
* Strong knowledge of safety metrics and programs.
* TPM mastery
* **Previous experience leading a turnaround factory**
* Extrusion technical skills
* ERP system knowledge a plus.
* LEAN Manufacturing Training or CI Management Experience (Tier I, II, III)

**Functional Success Drivers:** These competencies are what we require for an individual to be successful in this role.

* Strategic Skills
* Leadership
* Result Oriented
* Safety & Security
* Communication (Oral & Written)
* Analytical Skills
* Inspiring “Followership”
* Vision

 
**Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

The Company does not sponsor for employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

**Reasonable Accommodation Statement**

To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities.

Signode is committed to providing equal opportunities to all qualified applicants, including providing reasonable accommodations during our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodation in applying for this position, please contact us at HRRecruiting@Signode.com.

Plant Manager – Level 3 Water Treatment PlantNorth Greene Utilities (NGU)Baileyton, Tennessee

North Greene Utilities is seeking a certified Level 3 Water Treatment Plant Manager to lead operations at our Level 3 water treatment production plant in Baileyton Tennessee. This is a key leadership role responsible for the full management of plant functions, regulatory compliance, and a small team of operators.

Position Overview

The Plant Manager oversees all day-to-day and long-term operations of NGU’s Level 3 water treatment plant. The position ensures continuous production of safe, high-quality water that meets or exceeds all Tennessee Department of Environment and Conservation (TDEC) and U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) standards and guidance. The manager supervises, mentors, and develops a team of three subordinates while maintaining efficient, safe, and compliant plant operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage all plant functions and treatment processes to meet TDEC and EPA regulatory requirements and policy guidance.• Supervise, mentor, and train three subordinates. Two subordinates are expected to achieve Level 1 certification by mid-2027.• Develop, implement, and manage shift schedules to ensure continuous, reliable plant coverage.• Ensure compliance with all federal and state safety regulations and NGU safety protocols.• Conduct lifecycle and operational management of treatment infrastructure, including maintenance planning and capital needs.• Participate in daily stand-up meetings with the NGU management team.• Assist with HR requirements for subordinates, including ensuring compliance with company policies.• Monitor the health and welfare of subordinates.• Conduct biannual performance counseling for subordinates.• Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to evolving operational requirements and tasks as directed by the Operations Supervisor and General Manager.• Maintain accurate records, reporting, and documentation required for regulatory compliance and internal management.

Qualifications

* Current Tennessee Level 3 Water Treatment Operator certification (required).• Proven experience in water treatment plant operations, preferably in a leadership or supervisory role.• Strong knowledge of TDEC and EPA drinking water regulations, treatment processes, and compliance requirements.• Ability to supervise, train, and develop staff.• Valid driver’s license and ability to meet any additional job-related certifications or requirements (e.g., safety, drug and alcohol screening).• Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.• Commitment to safety, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement.

Compensation and Benefits

NGU offers very competitive wages, an IRA, health insurance, and dental coverage. Additional details on pay and benefits will be discussed with qualified candidates.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a resume, copy of current Level 3 certification, and contact information to .

For questions, contact the office at 423-234-3145.

Benefits:

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Join us to create change and have an impact in homes around the world.**

At Electrolux Group, our vision is to be the home appliance industry leader in consumer satisfaction by delivering outstanding lifetime experiences with solutions that always get better. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver more enjoyable and sustainable living.

**All About the Role**

The Manufacturing Engineering Director is a results-driven manufacturing leader responsible for engineering, maintenance, and technical operations within a heavy manufacturing environment. Drives equipment reliability, productivity, quality, and operational performance through continuous improvement, preventive and predictive maintenance, process optimization, and capital project execution. Leads investments in automation, AI, and digital manufacturing technologies while managing budgets, developing high-performing teams, and supporting operational excellence and new product introductions.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead manufacturing engineers, maintenance managers, and technicians to optimize production processes, equipment performance, and maintenance strategies.
* Develop, review, and approve specifications, quotations, labor requirements, tooling, and capital equipment investments.
* Participate in design reviews and approve engineering drawings, routings, specifications, and manufacturing documentation.
* Oversee equipment procurement, installation, commissioning, and capital improvement projects.
* Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions to resolve production, equipment, and maintenance-related issues.
* Collaborate closely with production and engineering teams to implement process improvements and support operational excellence initiatives.
* Ensure preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs are effective and sustain equipment reliability.
* Develop and manage maintenance budgets while maintaining cost-effective operations.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on uptime, quality, productivity, scrap reduction, and cycle time improvements.
* Provide leadership, coaching, and technical guidance to engineering and maintenance teams.
* Manage manufacturing-related capital (CAPEX) and operating budgets, including investment planning, business case development, cost control, resource allocation, and ROI tracking for equipment, automation, AI initiatives, digital technologies, and facility improvements.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, electronic, or related Engineering discipline preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of manufacturing engineering and maintenance leadership experience in a heavy manufacturing environment, including leading engineering and maintenance teams.
* Strong expertise in preventive, predictive, and corrective autonomous maintenance systems, equipment reliability, and operational efficiency improvement.
* Hands-on experience with PLCs, controls, programming, motors, hydraulics, pneumatics, and automated manufacturing equipment.
* Solid understanding of manufacturing processes, production equipment, plant layouts, tooling, and capital project management.
* Experience with steel forming, roll forming, power presses, enameling cutting systems, conveyors, fixtures, and tooling.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex equipment issues and perform root cause analysis to drive uptime, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Proficient in reading technical drawings, blueprints, schematics, engineering documentation, and utilizing computerized maintenance systems (CMMS).
* Strong project management, organizational, collaboration, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Drive labor productivity improvements through workforce planning, process optimization, performance management, and continuous improvement initiatives to achieve operational and cost-efficiency targets.
* Lead the implementation and optimization of AI, automation, and digital manufacturing technologies to improve operational performance, productivity, quality, and data-driven decision-making across manufacturing operations.

**Where you’ll be:**

This position will be based in Springfield, TN.

**Benefits highlights:**

* Medical, dental, vision and life insurance.
* Competitive holiday and vacation time off program.
* Retirement Savings Plan (401(k)) with relevant company contribution
* Discounted products and an EAP upon hire and tuition reimbursement after 12 months of service.

**Please be advised that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position at this time.**

**Find more on:**

Electrolux Group North America: https://www.linkedin.com/company/electrolux/life/northamerica/

Electrolux Group Careers: https://career.electroluxgroup.com/global/en

**As part of Electrolux Group, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.**

Electrolux Home Products, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request through hrsnorthamerica@electrolux.com. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

The Senior Director, Manufacturing & Test Engineering is a strategic technical leader responsible for driving operational excellence, modernizing engineering capabilities, and scaling manufacturing and test processes across Mercury. This leader will guide multi-site teams to ensure world‑class quality, cost efficiency, and delivery performance.

This role is central to advancing Mercury's production readiness and technology transformation initiatives. It requires an influential leader who can operate at both strategic and hands-on levels, collaborating across Operations, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and Executive Leadership.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary team responsible for manufacturing engineering, test engineering, automation engineering, and new product introduction (NPI).
* Create and execute long-term strategies for manufacturing and test capability, capacity, and technology investment across Mercury.
* Drive design-for-manufacturability (DFM), design-for-test (DFT), and factory digitalization initiatives to improve efficiency, quality, and product scalability.
* Own manufacturing and test readiness for new product introductions, ensuring seamless transition from design to full-rate production.
* Oversee development, implementation, and continuous improvement of automated test solutions and manufacturing processes.
* Champion lean manufacturing and operational excellence methodologies to achieve measurable improvements in yield, throughput, and cost.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Program Leadership to ensure manufacturability and testability are integrated early in the product lifecycle.
* Establish performance metrics and dashboards to track key indicators related to quality, delivery, cost, and engineering productivity.
* Ensure compliance with industry and regulatory standards (AS9100, IPC, DoD requirements, etc.).
* Build, mentor, and empower a high-performing engineering organization with a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing, or related discipline)
* Typically requires 12+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience, including managing manufacturing and/or test engineering organizations within high‑mix, high‑reliability electronics or aerospace/defense environments.
* Experience scaling operations, implementing manufacturing automation, and improving test architectures.
* Experience with electronics manufacturing processes (PCB assembly, system integration, functional test, environmental test).
* Experience with lean/continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience leading multi-site teams and influence across matrixed organizations.
* Excellent communication, strategic thinking, and executive-level presentation skills.
* This position requires you to have **or** obtain a government security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Operations, Systems Engineering, or an MBA with a technical background.
* Proven leadership in scaling automated test systems, digital manufacturing, Industry 4.0, or smart factory initiatives.
* Deep expertise in RF, microwave, embedded systems, or complex PCB/system-level test methodologies.
* Demonstrated success implementing enterprise-wide continuous improvement or lean transformations.
* Strong background integrating manufacturing engineering with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and ERP systems.

**Job Title**

Director of Manufacturing

**Position Overview**

Shaw is hiring a Director of Manufacturing to provide strategic and operational leadership for multiple manufacturing facilities with extrusion, twisting, and heat set operations. This role is responsible for driving world-class performance in safety, quality, service, cost, people development, and operational excellence across all manufacturing.

 

The Director of Manufacturing partners closely with plant leadership, technical organizations, supply chain, engineering, maintenance, quality, human resources, business leadership and other Directors of Manufacturing to ensure seamless execution of objectives while developing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, innovation, and associate engagement. The position is accountable for achieving business results while building organizational capability and leadership bench strength across all locations.

 

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute a multi-site manufacturing strategy aligned with business objectives and long-term growth plans.

* Establish clear operational priorities and performance expectations for all facilities.

* Lead large-scale improvements, capital investments, automation initiatives, start-ups, expansions, consolidations, and transformational change efforts.

* Drive operational excellence through Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies.

* Partner with commercial, product, technical, and supply chain teams to ensure manufacturing capabilities support customer and market needs.

* Provide leadership and oversight for extrusion, twisting, heat set, and supporting operations across all assigned facilities.

* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) across facilities and drive accountability for results.

* Optimize asset utilization, labor productivity, throughput, and manufacturing efficiencies.

* Ensure consistent execution of manufacturing standards, operating disciplines, and best practices across locations.

* Lead efforts to improve reliability, process capability, and operational stability.

* Champion a culture where safety is the highest priority and established as a core value.

* Ensure compliance with all environmental, regulatory, and company requirements.

* Drive continuous improvement in product quality and customer satisfaction.

* Drive cost reduction initiatives while maintaining product quality and service performance.

* Monitor financial performance and implement actions to improve profitability and return on investment.

* Lead, coach, and develop Plant Managers and manufacturing leadership teams.

* Build organizational capability through succession planning, leadership development, and talent reviews.

* Foster a culture of inclusion, engagement, accountability, and continuous learning.
 

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.

* Minimum of 5 years leading multi-department or multi-site manufacturing operations.

* Experience in extrusion, yarn manufacturing, twisting, heat set, polymer, textile, fiber, chemical, or related process manufacturing environments.

* Demonstrated success leading large teams and developing leaders.

* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, and operational excellence methodologies.

* Ability to travel regularly between facilities 25-50%.
 

Leadership Competencies

* Establish Strategic Direction

* Drive Results

* Demonstrate Strategic Influence

* Lead Change

Build Successful Teams

8 Hr non-rotating shift, Hrs fall to in punch day, Observed Calendar, shift starts AM

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Senior Manager Quality Compliance**

**Working at Abbott** 
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists

**The Opportunity** 
This position works out of our Plymouth, MN location in the **Electrophysiology** division, we’re advancing the treatment of heart and vascular disease through breakthrough medical technologies, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

As the **Senior Manager Quality Compliance**, you’ll provide leadership for quality system compliance initiatives, audit readiness, regulatory change management, field actions, and quality compliance strategy across the EP business. This role leads teams and collaborates across functions to strengthen compliance capabilities, support inspections and audits, and drive continuous improvement

**What You’ll Work On**

* Lead quality compliance programs, including external audit support, inspection readiness activities, and quality system effectiveness initiatives.
* Develop and execute compliance strategies for the EP business, strengthening audit capability across sites and functions.
* Manage and support Health Hazard Evaluation (HHE), RRE/SRE, field action, and remediation activities to ensure timely and compliant execution.
* Assess industry trends, regulatory changes, and standards updates, implementing solutions that advance organizational compliance.
* Lead and mentor team members while partnering with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve compliance objectives.

Quality Management Systems/Compliance

* Support life cycle of external audits (ie. execution, preparation, completion, etc).
* Drive site audit readiness for FDA & NB
* Expand compliance capabilities to support IA
* Support Certificate Management and Finance Portfolio Management
* Manage HHE and Field Action Program
* Impact Analysis on Industry Trends
* Manage Field Action Strategy, as appropriate
* As needed, support regulation and standards change assessment

People Management & Strategy

* Lead diverse team to achieve compliance goals
* Develop compliance strategy for EP BU
* Develop audit capability across EP sites and functions
* Demonstrate Compliance Expertise through Leadership Behaviors

Lead Strategic Quality & Compliance Programs

* Develop and execute global quality and compliance strategies that align with divisional priorities and long-term business objectives.
* Build and manage program roadmaps, business cases, budgets, funding requests, and implementation plans for complex, multi-workstream initiatives.
* Establish meaningful partnerships across Quality, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Commercial organizations to drive successful program execution.
* Present program strategies, progress updates, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

Strengthen Audit Readiness & Inspection Success

* Lead and support the lifecycle of external audits, including preparation, execution, response management, and follow-up activities.
* Drive ongoing inspection readiness across global sites, including preparedness for FDA, Notified Body, and other regulatory inspections.
* Partner with site and functional leaders to identify compliance gaps, implement remediation plans, and sustain inspection readiness programs.

Advance the Global Quality Management System

* Ensure effective implementation and governance of quality programs within the division's Quality Management System.
* Assess and manage impacts of evolving global regulations, standards, and industry expectations.
* Own and coordinate standards and regulation change management activities, including impact assessments and implementation plans.
* Support certificate management activities and external certification requirements.

Lead Compliance Improvement & Risk Reduction Efforts

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance compliance effectiveness, operational efficiency, and quality performance.
* Identify opportunities to leverage technology, automation, analytics, AI-enabled solutions, training programs, and process improvements.
* Monitor quality metrics, program effectiveness, and compliance trends to proactively mitigate risk.
* Manage and communicate program dashboards and executive-level reporting.

Support Critical Quality Events & Field Actions

* Provide leadership and support for field action strategies and implementation activities when required.
* Support Health Hazard Evaluation (HHE), Risk Review Evaluation (RRE), and Software Risk Evaluation (SRE) programs to ensure timely completion and compliance.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to effectively manage quality records, communications, and closure activities.

Develop a Culture of Quality

* Mentor and advise colleagues across the organization on compliant decision-making and quality best practices.
* Enhance organizational compliance capabilities through training, consultation, and knowledge sharing.
* Monitor industry trends and emerging compliance risks to help shape future quality strategies and organizational readiness.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Industrial Technology, or a related field.
* 13+ years of combined experience in Quality, Compliance, Manufacturing Operations, Regulatory Affairs, or related functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading large, cross-functional programs in a regulated industry.
* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems and compliance processes.
* Previous management experience.
* Experience influencing stakeholders and driving results in a matrixed global organization.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and executive-facing leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Medical device, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated industry experience.
* Experience supporting FDA inspections, Notified Body audits, MDSAP, ISO standards, or related regulatory environments.
* International experience and/or foreign language proficiency.
* Experience with audit readiness programs, field actions, regulatory change management, and quality system governance.
* Strong analytical and business acumen with the ability to connect compliance requirements to operational and business outcomes

.

***Job Title: Senior Manager,*** ***MAC Capacity Expansion & Digital Factory Integration***

***Job Code: 46616***

***Job Location: Remote***

***Job Schedule: Varies***

**Job Description:**

The Advanced Operations Technology (AOT) organization is seeking an experienced and visionary Senior Manager, Digital Factory, to lead the strategy, architecture, and implementation of digital manufacturing technologies across our solid rocket motor manufacturing enterprise. This role serves as the organizational owner and subject matter authority for the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), Operational Technology (OT) infrastructure and architecture, Auto-ID systems, manufacturing technology visualization, Key Performance Indicator (KPI) frameworks, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) tools, and data-driven optimization of manufacturing processes and automation equipment performance.

The Senior Manager, Digital Factory will work at the intersection of manufacturing operations, information technology, and advanced engineering to build a connected, intelligent, and highly efficient factory ecosystem. This leader will define and execute a multi-year digital factory roadmap that enables real-time visibility, predictive analytics, and continuous improvement across all manufacturing sites.

This role reports to the Director of Advanced Operations Technology and will collaborate closely with the AOT Chief Engineer, automation engineering teams, IT/OT leadership, program managers, and site operations leadership.

**Essential Functions:**

**Strategy & Roadmap:**

 

* Define, own, and execute the enterprise-wide Digital Factory strategy, aligning with organizational goals for manufacturing modernization, capacity expansion, and operational excellence.
* Develop and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap covering IIoT, OT infrastructure, Auto-ID, AI/ML integration, visualization platforms, and digital twin capabilities.
* Identify emerging digital manufacturing technologies and assess their applicability and ROI for integration into the manufacturing environment.

**Execution:**

 

* Partner with lead systems architect to define and govern OT network architecture standards, and systems integration (ERP, MES, SCADA, Historian) ensuring secure, scalable, and reliable connectivity between shop floor assets and enterprise systems.
* Lead the strategy and implementation of Auto-ID technologies including barcode, RFID, and other identification and tracking systems to enable end-to-end manufacturing traceability.
* Collaborate with quality, manufacturing engineering, and supply chain teams to ensure Auto-ID solutions meet traceability and compliance requirements.
* Establish the strategy to implement manufacturing dashboards, visualization platforms, and digital work instruction systems that provide real-time operational visibility to all levels of the organization.
* Partner with operations and program leadership to ensure KPI data is actionable and drives continuous improvement initiatives.
* Lead the identification, evaluation, and implementation of AI and ML tools to optimize manufacturing processes, predict equipment failures, reduce waste, and improve throughput.

**Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

 

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of digital factory engineers and technology specialists, providing direction, performance management, and career development support.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including automation engineers, manufacturing engineers, process engineers, quality, maintenance, IT, OT, safety, and Integrated Product Team (IPT) leads to ensure seamless integration of digital factory solutions.
* Manage external vendors, system integrators, and technology partners supporting digital factory initiatives.
* Manage projects from concept to completion, including resource allocation, timeline management, and budget adherence.
* Ensure all digital factory solutions comply with applicable regulatory, cybersecurity, and quality standards.
* Ability to obtain a US secret security clearance.
* Travel:10%.

**Qualifications**:

 

* Bachelor’s Degree with a minimum of 12 years of prior digital manufacturing, OT/IIoT systems, manufacturing technology experience. Graduate Degree with a minimum of 10 years of prior digital manufacturing, OT/IIoT systems, manufacturing technology experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 16 years of prior digital manufacturing, OT/IIoT systems, manufacturing technology experience.
* 5 years experience designing, deploying, and sustaining IIoT platforms and OT network architectures in a manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

 

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology is preferred.
* Experience leading and managing a team of digital, OT, or manufacturing technology engineers.
* Experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES) and their integration with shop floor equipment and enterprise systems.
* Experience with OT/IT convergence, including integration of shop floor systems (SCADA, PLC, DCS, Historians) with enterprise systems (ERP, MES).
* Experience developing and implementing KPI frameworks and manufacturing performance dashboards.
* Experience with data acquisition, edge computing, and industrial networking protocols (e.g., OPC-UA, MQTT, Modbus, EtherNet/IP).
* Experience developing statements of work, functional requirements specifications, and technology roadmap documents.
